93387.description:
Every time I leave my hut, I return to a mess and soggy little murloc footprints.

I am plannin' a different approach to deal with those pestersome amphibian encroachers, but I need to sort out some ingredients.

While I work out my list for those pests--there is a ghost named Jelvik dat keeps after me for somethin'. Tell him to move along.
93387.title: Dealing with Pests

93388.description:
My list is ready. I need you to gather de ingredients to keep dem murlocs away for good.

First, talk to Maka de Trawler. He and de kelpweaver from Torga's Beak like to catch fish in de inlet. Bring me some fish guts--disgustin' and perfect.

Next, head out to Mlurkkr Mire. I need dat dirty ol' pearl dey think is so special.

While you're in de Mire, relieve some of dem irritatin' serpent folk of some scales.

Mind you, I only want de good ones.
93388.title: Unusual Alchemy

93389.description:
I've been here so long dat pieces of my memory are lost to time. I feel an emptiness for something I loved.

There will be no rest for me until I know who or what it was. I can only remember one word... Rocksblood. I don't know who or what dat is.

Check de murloc ruins to de south. There's someone who can point you in de right direction.

Since Ofi is bein' stubborn, I need you to help me remember.
93389.title: Rocksblood

93390.description:
Dis part is gonna be fun.

I got de mixture started. It is already unpleasant, but now we will make it really vile.

When you feel mentally prepared to be a useful one again, let me know.
93390.title: Acceptable Apprentice

93391.description:
Best you move our little deterrents out to de strip of land between my home and de maniacs' mire.

They may try to stop you, but hold fast. If it works, dey will be running with their tails between their legs.

Do murlocs even have tails?
93391.title: Make it Stinky

93392.description:
To de northeast, there's a small island. I remember long ago a great roarin' and howlin' dat echoed across de waters.

I could hear de anger, but there was also pain. I could not venture to dat place. What if I became lost, my own feelings swallowed by de bigger ones?

One day, it became quiet again, but now I feel dis is de final key to de lock on my soul.

Go there. Find de last piece.
93392.title: Recovering Memories

93393.description:
You know, my friend, as happy as I am... I keep thinkin' how sad we made dat beast. I do not wish dat feelin' on another livin' soul.

He took care of dear Sava for all de years she was lost. Could you help us with one last request?

If you could bring him a friend of his own, it will repay our debt.

Then we can move on once and for all--me and Sava will be free.
93393.title: A Little Kindness

93396.description:
Veraan... alive...

<Kifaan shakes his head in disbelief.>

I've spent countless hours running this moment through my head, but now that it's here, I find myself grasping for words...

The Shadowguard attempted to raise Dimensius to power... they've sworn fealty to Xal'atath as she wages war on worlds. Am I supposed to just... pretend none of that happened? Is THAT what my oaths to family require?

And what of Veraan? Does she regret her involvement?

I should check on her.
93396.title: Bursting at the Seams

93400.description:
Ahh, Hallow's End. The perfect time for spooky stories, glowing pumpkins, and sweet, sweet candy!

But this year, I want to craft something truly unforgettable. A delicious range of candy inspired from regions across Azeroth!

For that, I've enlisted some help. A certain... eccentric culinary genius. You may know him. I've sent him off to Duskwood in search of haunted recipes that are sure to thrill everyone.

Find him and bring back some of those cursed candies.
93400.title: Sugar Run

93401.description: Quite the risk taker! Honey Drops are delicious, but can be a pain to retrieve - literally! Don't expect a warm welcome from the habitants of the hives that you will be extracting Honey Drops from.
93401.title: Howling Honey Drops

93409.description: <The fallen scout's body bears terrible wounds, but still clutches tightly to a report detailing an imminent Vilebranch attack on Atal'Aman.>
93409.title: Delver's Call: Atal'Aman

93410.description:
The ancient Amani crypts near the Broken Throne have been overrun.

Clear them of interlopers before the dead within can be defiled further.
93410.title: Delver's Call: Twilight Crypts

93413.description:
Zul'jan is the one who did this to Zul'jarra. He needs to answer for what he did to his sister.

Now, we gather Zul'jarra's forces. Let them know that her hash'uras have come once again to aid the Amani.
93413.title: TO DEPRECATE Battle for Zul'jarra

93414.description:
Has Zul'jan really thrown in his lot with these snakes? I don't understand what possible reason he'd join with these monsters. What promises did they make him?

Zul'jan will face retribution in time. But first, these so-called Children of Ula'tek will. We'll carve a swath through them to the temple, together.
93414.title: TO DEPRECATE Bloody Mercy

93416.description:
Rumors of disturbances in the Gulf of Memory have begun to spread.

Deal with the issue before it can take root.
93416.title: Delver's Call: The Gulf of Memory

93417.description:
Orweyna told us what she saw...

Damn it, Zul'jan! Does he truly not understand what he's done? Despite what we have accomplished, he sees the bonds Zul'jarra forged with the both of us as weakness and chases this idea of a "supreme Amani Empire" still.

And in the process, he has gravely wounded his sister.

But maybe Zul'jarra is right--maybe he doesn't know.

We have to get that dagger. By making him see sense, or by force.
93417.title: The Vaults of Atal'Utek: Altar of Fangs

93418.description:
I saw things in de venom haze.

Heard Zul'jan screamin', felt what's eatin' away at him. 

Heard Malacrass whisperin' in his ear.

Ula'tek has haunted de Amani from de beginning. De lengths we went to for power and empire, and de blood it cost...

Dat wasn't greatness. Deep down, Zul'jan knows it too.

Malacrass stole my grandfather from me. I won't let him take Zul'jan too.
93418.title: The Venomous Abyss

93419.description:
The Fang is cursed from the summoning of Ula'tek. We can use it to cure Zul'jarra. I just--

We have to act fast. She's fading!
93419.title: Nature of Her Wounds

93420.description:
We need to tell Lor'themar what happened here. Meet me in Silvermoon.

As for Zul'jarra... she needs time. She needs her people, and her people need her.

She will survive this. I am sure of it. She must!
93420.title: Lor'themar's Judgement

93421.description:
<This moldy hanging has been crudely painted over to depict one fungarian hitting another with what looks to be a chair.>

See big fight. Best fight!

Grudge Pit. Be there!
93421.title: Delver's Call: The Grudge Pit

93423.description:
Mysterious creatures are out in the wild across the Eversong Woods. 

Go and see what you can find out about them.
93423.title: Sparks of War: Eversong Woods

93424.description:
There's unknown danger out in Zul'Aman.

Get out there and clear things up!
93424.title: Sparks of War: Zul'Aman

93425.description: Powerful creatures have grown through the lands across Harandar. Go look into it.
93425.title: Sparks of War: Harandar

93426.description: Chaotic forces are being disruptive in the Voidstorm. Go investigate and clear things up!
93426.title: Sparks of War: Voidstorm

93427.description:
<A note is pinned to the slain voidwalker.>

Sunkiller Sanctum is a den of Xal'atath's most pathetic sycophants.

I encourage any mercenaries, adventurers, or general do-gooders who happen upon this bounty to pay it a visit and dispense the justice you are all so happy to talk on and on about.

 - Perodius
93427.title: Delver's Call: Sunkiller Sanctum

93428.description:
Witness the fates of those who bend their neck to Xal'atath.

I issue a challenge to any creature of Void or flesh. Pursue the nearby ethereals and dispatch anyone who serves the so-called Harbinger.

 - Perodius
93428.title: Delver's Call: Shadowguard Point

93432.description:
First Mor'duun and the Blade ambush Atal'Aman. Now it's overrun by these "echoes..."

At least, that's what Doru calls them: echoes. All I see are ghosts of a bloodier time. And like those days, no matter how many we cut through, they never stop swarming in.

Get out there and see for yourself. Bring de echoes' remains as well. Doru wants to study what dey are and how dey work.
93432.title: Swords to Plowshares

93433.description:
Curse de echoes. 

Curse Zul'jin, and Mor'duun, and dat snake Malacrass too.

They only cause more mess for de livin' to clean up.

Listen, hash'ura. I need you to deliver supplies to each of de shrines in de city. We've packaged food, water, bandages, and reagents to keep their barriers at full strength.

Ask about their status as well. Though safe, they all likely feel boxed in.
93433.title: Shrine, Sealed, Delivered

93435.description:
De scouts report seein' a few unique faces among de echoes. I felt old angers rising when I heard de names.

Dey were not honorable fighters for us to challenge ourselves against, such as yourself. They were vermin--greedy opportunists that drove legions of connivin' adventurers to rob us of our possessions, our treasures, and... our tusks.

Slayin' de echoes of these key figures should reduce de number of echoes appearin'.

And it will make me grin to know they've fallen.
93435.title: Four Instigators

93436.description:
I will study de ashes you acquired, but we can get dis situation under control by means other than de axe.

You must disrupt de battlefield, hash'ura. De echoes believe dey're in de midst of a decades-old battle, so we must target de support dey relied on back then.

Poison de feasts dey find respite at, hex their disrespectful civilian allies, and sabotage dat chest they seem so keen on lootin'!
93436.title: Hex the Innocent, Disrupt the Guilty

93437.description:
After studying de ashes, Doru believes we can only fight with de past using weapons of de past.

I cannot ask this of any Amani. Or Witherbark, Revantusk, or Shadowpine. Ya presence with us in these times must be fate... because we could only make this request to an outsider.

Ya must inhabit a soul of de profane ones: those that accepted Malacrass's vile bargain and consumed loa power during de era of Zul'jin.

Return to de shrine of de profane one ya wish to merge with.

Ancestors forgive us...
93437.title: In Their Own Blood

93440.description:
With Mor'duun slain and de Twilight's Blade defeated, my people want to return to Atal'Aman.

It should be a moment of great celebration but... somethin' unexpected is barrin' our way.

Seek out Torundo and Elder Doru. Dey are supportin' de resettlement. They'll know how best to use your talents.

Prepare yourself, hash'ura, and do not hesitate to defend Atal'Aman no matter who you meet there.
93440.title: Personal History

93449.description:
A group of my people went over to Mlurkkr Mire and have not returned. Dey were looking into an incursion of de Children of Ula'tek in de region. There are also troubling reports of de local murlocs actin' more violent than usual, and de priest Wa'kani said she detected a strong dark energy she wanted to check out.

Their leader, Zawadi, was due to report back an hour ago. Will you go find dem and lend aid if needed?
93449.title: Trouble in the Swamp

93452.description:
<It seems the minions of the Greench have fled, leaving behind a small mangled, but still salvageable present.

Perhaps one of the Winter Festivities planners would be able to help return it to the original intended recipient.>
93452.title: Retrieved Crumpled Present

93453.description:
Dearly Departed,

Having just tasted the bitter sting of mortality, there seems no better time to discuss with you the oft ignored subject of death and memorialization. Of what you leave behind in a real, physical sense.

Leave discussion of love and other such frivolities to the philosophers and dandies. I speak of cold, hard stone and the deeds carved upon it.

Find me in Silvermoon.
93453.title: A Grave Concern

93454.description:
Malacrass helped my grandfather lead de Amani to ruin. Now he's gonna do de same to my brother. If we could just separate de two of them... 

But Jan won't listen.

He thinks Ula'tek is a weapon dat will bring de return of de Amani Empire. After de vision he saw--and who knows what else Malacrass told him--I can't convince him otherwise.

De hash'ey requires counsel, my hash'ura. Gather de others and join me.
93454.title: Words to Hear

93495.description:
The sands of time flow back and forth like ocean waves.

Journey once more through the timeways, to the time of Dragon Aspects and Primal Incarnates.

Bring me tales of victory in an era of great adventure and danger.
93495.title: A Soaring Journey Through Time

93497.description:
It was a time of forging new alliances and enemies. Reminisce with me about the great Dragon Aspects and their return to glory.

Venture back in time to the Dragon Isles and return with what knowledge you can.
93497.title: A Soaring Path Through Time

93499.description: An important test to being a strong warrior is coordinating with others in combat. Find fellow combatants to join you in battle in the arena.
93499.title: Enshrouded in Arenas

93501.description:
Things have started to get interesting, {name}. I'm hearing of all sorts of treasures popping up in delves.

I'm compiling my notes in this book, and our illustrious hosts have even broken out some of their own artifacts to trade for what we uncover.

Why don't you take a look before we head out. Better prepared than dead.
93501.title: The Season Starts: Midnight

93502.description: Independence is key to excel in battle. Display your solo capabilities in then come back to me.
93502.title: Enshrouded Solo

93503.description: The ability to work with a group to take objectives is key in training. Practice this on the battlefield.
93503.title: Enshrouded in Teamwork

93504.description: Practice makers perfect. A great place to practice is with others like yourself looking to practice. Set off and find others like yourself to practice small-scale skirmishes, then return to me.
93504.title: Enshrouded in Skirmishes

93505.description: Large conflicts get you to take a look at the larger picture. Give it a try then come back to me.
93505.title: Enshrouded in War

93506.description: You can learn a lot on the battlefield on your own. Go ahead and see what you observe.
93506.title: Enshrouded in Battle

93511.description:
He took him! Finley...big...purple...man!

<Reno is clearly distraught and both physically and emotionally exhausted.>
93511.title: A Missing Member

93519.description:
Things are starting to get interesting in Delves.

Come see me in Silvermoon.
93519.title: Midnight Delves!

93525.description:
That thing looked tough, and it took Reno out as an afterthought.

We'll want the best gear we can get before trying to take it down.

Thankfully, I have some leads on bountiful delves we can start with.
93525.title: Nulling Nullaeus

93575.description:
I will not leave my people to die to de Vilebranch's dark rituals. We must go after dem.

The heart of Maisara Caverns is where de Vilebranch keep their secrets. I expect dis to be a bloody trip. We will have to face de ugliness of the Vilebranch greed, and what it is costin' all of us.

We must discover what purpose they have for my stolen kin. If any still be alive. I will be dere to aid you... but bring a fierce party of warriors. We will need it.
93575.title: Maisara Caverns: Maisara Hungers

93576.description:
While you were keepin' de snakes busy, I was lookin' for Wa'kani and de other scouts. De scouts are still missin', but Wa'kani is in dat temple over there.

I tried gettin' closer, but it's too heavily guarded. You should have no problem, though. Please rescue my fool sista before de snakes do something foul to her.
93576.title: The Search for Wa'kani

93581.description: Friends - I sense some troubles out there. There's foes out there that harbor grudges and are looking for a fight. Join others and show those looking for a battle who is mighty.
93581.title: Against Overwhelming Odds

93582.description: Friends - I sense some troubles out there. There's foes out there that harbor grudges and are looking for a fight. Join others and show those looking for a battle who is mighty.
93582.title: Against Overwhelming Odds

93586.description:
I be sent out here ta prove dat I can be an amani warrior.

Dis trial needs me ta collect as many trophies from dese gnarldin as possible. 

De two of us should work together! I be helpin' you get recognized as an amani warrior, yeah?

Just go out dere and get as many trophies from de gnarldin as possible. 

I be stayin' behind ta watch our backs, eh?
93586.title: Conditional - Multiple Objectives, Non Sequenced

93593.description:
Ours is a world of constant struggle, wouldn't you agree? Even in between times of peace, there is value in keeping one's battle skills sharpened.

I have heard much of your prowess. Let us see what you are capable of.
93593.title: A Call to Battle

93595.description:
Seeking out challenge and treasure can test one's skills, all while uncovering that which will give us even greater power.

Were I you, I would delve into places that provide both.
93595.title: A Call to Delves

93598.description:
It is only when we push ourselves beyond our limits that we truly grow... or fail and make way for others.

Prove yourself by challenging the deadliest of places. Shorel'aran.
93598.title: Emissary of War

93599.description:
Even the smallest amongst us must play their part. That includes our little friends.

If you would strengthen both their prowess and your bond, challenge others. Only the fittest will survive.
93599.title: The Very Best

93600.description:
Old, musty dungeons and battlefields are one thing, but the arena is where the wheat and the chaff are separated.

Can you prove yourself, {class}? Show me. Let me hear your name shouted from the stands by those crying for blood.
93600.title: The Arena Calls

93605.description:
Sinu a'manore, {class}. It is true in the past, I have been less than... egalitarian in my outlook. Yet in these times of trouble, there is much to be done--whether here in Quel'Thalas or elsewhere.

Will you face the challenge and prove yourself once more?
93605.title: The World Awaits

93607.description:
Greetings, {class}. You come to me because you seek answers. I have nothing for you but guidance.

Perhaps the answers you seek lie in the past? Return to that time mere years after the conclusion of the Third War. Face its threats once again and see what wisdom you can glean.
93607.title: An Original Path Through Time

93608.description:
On the other side of the Dark Portal lies Outland. I've never been--my history is tied to the Kirin Tor rather than Silvermoon. Yet the elves of Quel'Thalas went through much turmoil during that period of time. 

Perhaps you could learn a thing or two from that fractured world. Take up the challenge, if you feel worthy of it.
93608.title: A Burning Path Through Time

93610.description:
The lessons of the past must be revisited from time to time and brought back to the present as a reminder.

Walk the timeways and return to when the Lich King and the armies of the Scourge emerged from the icy wastes of Northrend and threatened all of Azeroth. There is much to be learned from that time.
93610.title: A Frozen Path Through Time

93611.description:
The Cataclysm was terrifying for all of Azeroth. The existential threat of Deathwing echoes down through the ages. Isn't it interesting that no matter how things change, such threats return time and time again, but in different forms?

Go back and face those threats again. See if there's something new to learn from the past.
93611.title: A Shattered Path Through Time

93612.description:
My memories of Pandaria are... complicated, {class}. Many lessons were learned during that tumultuous period of time--some good, some painful. 

The world has changed a great deal since then. We've all changed--I hope for the better.

Travel back through the mists of time. Relearn what lessons you can.
93612.title: A Shrouded Path Through Time

93613.description:
Perhaps you can untangle the depth of knowledge to be found in Draenor--not the shattered remains of Outland, but the Draenor of the Iron Horde. It is, in its own ways, just as harsh if not harsher than Outland ever was. 

See what wisdom you can find there.
93613.title: A Savage Path Through Time

93614.description:
I have faced many enemies, but the Burning Legion was perhaps the greatest threat our world ever faced. At least... until now.

Of course, there are our inner demons to contend with as well.

Do you still have what it takes to defeat the Burning Legion?
93614.title: A Fel Path Through Time

93627.description:
I remember well the battles of the Alliance and Horde that played out in Kul Tiras and Zandalar. Return there, relive the memories. 

Will you seek glory, or knowledge? Or perhaps both?
93627.title: A Scarred Path Through Time

93628.description:
Would you return to the realm of death and risk your very existence? Rebirth, eternal peace, endless torment? All can be found across the veil. 

Travel to the Shadowlands once more. If you can defeat its most dangerous places, perhaps you will return to the living wiser and more powerful.
93628.title: A Shadowed Path Through Time

93640.description:
I had wanted to bring the tea set home to my wife to surprise her...

But that won't make up for me not bringing home any fish for supper.

Hm. I'll make a deal with you, {class}. I've been standing here all day trying to catch some fish for my beautiful wife to cook for us. But the crabs keep stealing my catch--and my bait! Run them off so I can catch and keep some fish, and I will give you this teapot.
93640.title: Fish Finagling

93641.description: Friends - I sense some troubles out there. There's foes out there that harbor grudges and are looking for a fight. Join others and show those looking for a battle who is mighty.
93641.title: Against Overwhelming Odds

93642.description: Friends - I sense some troubles out there. There's foes out there that harbor grudges and are looking for a fight. Join others and show those looking for a battle who is mighty.
93642.title: Against Overwhelming Odds

93651.description:
We have traced Ruia's flight through the Rootways. As we suspected, he has sought refuge deep within The Blinding Vale, where the Lightbloom first took root within Harandar.

With Alndust empowering our command of life, we are able to keep the Lightbloom from spreading uncontrolled. But we will run out of Alndust long before Ruia runs out of patience.

Ruia is wise and powerful. But his actions in Eversong prove that his conviction has grown into an uncontrollable fanaticism. He must be stopped.
93651.title: The Blinding Vale: Lightbloom Roots

93667.description:
You're not the first strange thing I've seen today.

<Scout Zel'kanra shakes her head.>

Saw a big, shelled creature along the path to Jan'Alor. Amaxi took a bunch of scouts and went after it.

They've been gone a while. Think you could check in on them?
93667.title: Camp Stonewash

93668.description:
Greetings, {class}. Have you heard of my joint venture with Aethas Sunreaver and Auric Sunchaser? We have been attempting to rekindle interest in an old arcane tournament of stealth versus perception, called Decor Duel.

We're currently training new players, so if you'd like to learn the ropes of the game, feel free to meet us in the Decor Duel training area, just west of here.
93668.title: An Old Game for a New Age

93683.description:
{name}! Glad to see you. The defenders in the fortress could use your help.

One of the gnomes built a robot to try to help defend the keep. However, it goes haywire every time it turns on.

She needs the help of someone who can properly disrupt the robot's attacks so it can be repaired.

Do you have a moment to help?
93683.title: Conditional Objectives - Singular

93690.description:
Welcome back, {class}. If you're still interested in working with the Artisan's Consortium, we would value your aid. We need highly skilled artisans to craft supplies for the war effort.

If your work meets Silvermoon's high standards of quality, please fill any public crafting orders you find on the board. You can also fill orders for yourself, your guildmates, or private patrons.

Bring back proof of completed orders and I'll see that you're adequately compensated.
93690.title: Alchemy Services Requested

93697.description:
Have you heard it? The magic of Eversong. It emanates a subtle melody, if you listen closely enough. The complex interwoven strands of magic move against each other and create a beautiful harmony.

The dust distilled from such magic is exceptionally potent. Bring some to me and I will show you its uses.
93697.title: Shimmering Melodies

93698.description:
When captured at just the right moment, the power exuding from an object can be crystallized into splinters of raw magical energy. The result is dazzling, like beams of sunlight splitting as they stream through a window.

Bring me some of these shards. My work cannot continue without them.
93698.title: Splintered Radiance

93699.description:
There is great magic in the dawn. It illuminates and awakens all it falls upon, rousing the land to action. It is potential in its purest form.

As enchanters, we can crystallize that potential. Bring a parcel of the dawn to me.
93699.title: A Ray of Sunlight

93700.description:
Are you an herbalist? Oh, thank goodness.

I've found myself in need of an exorbitant amount of tranquility bloom. The orders from the alchemists keep piling up and I only just finished restocking our argentleaf and--

<Nathera stops to take a deep breath.>

Could you please bring me as much tranquility bloom as you can carry? I'd be in your debt.
93700.title: Experience Tranquility

93701.description:
Argentleaf is always in high demand whenever war draws near.

It practically falls apart when you dry it out, but that powder can be used in a variety of medicines. It calms the nerves, focuses the mind, and can even work as a mild anesthetic in a pinch.

If you find any out in the field, please bring it to me.
93701.title: Brittle and Brilliant

93702.description:
Most tuberous roots have some sort of healing potential, but azeroot is by far the most potent and versatile.

Just a small amount, juiced or powdered, can stave off infections, promote healing, and soothe both body and mind. I've even seen it used to keep lumber from rotting!

If you could bring me a few bushels, I'll put it to good use.
93702.title: The Root of Life

93703.description:
While most of our harvests supply the scribes and alchemists in the city, we do occasionally receive orders from the public.

Lord Saltheril is one of our most prolific customers. He has an estate in western Eversong that he keeps well-supplied with offerings for guests at his soirees.

He has requested a large quantity of mana lilies and sanguithorn this week. Could you help us fulfill the order?
93703.title: Sin'dorei Vices

93704.description:
Tranquility bloom and argentleaf are the backbone of countless potions, elixirs, inks, and so much more.

It never hurts to keep a surplus around. If you find yourself with any extra, we would gladly take it off your hands.
93704.title: Traditional Harvests

93705.description:
It's easy to overlook in favor of more extravagant materials, but copper is an extremely reliable and versatile material. Weapons, armor, wiring, jewelry, and of course the humble copper coin--it does it all!

Naturally, copper is always in high demand across the city and beyond. If you happen across any extra ore, I would gladly take it off your hands.
93705.title: Copper for Your Thoughts?

93706.description:
There's been an influx of newly recruited soldiers lately. Marvelous fighters in the making, but a little too enthusiastic. They've already done a number on the stock of training weapons.

We usually make training weapons out of tin or other soft metals. They keep the recruits from doing real damage to the training dummies or each other, but they don't last long.

We'll need a lot more tin than what we have in stock to keep up. Bring us some more!
93706.title: Aggressive Tin-dencies

93707.description:
Elegant gold filigree may be a favorite of the sin'dorei, but our city also boasts some of the finest silversmiths in Azeroth.

They have been receiving a particularly high number of orders with all of the new visitors passing through. If you come across any high-quality silver, they can put it to good use.
93707.title: It's Called Silvermoon

93708.description:
Our arcane constructs might look purely magical, but there's quite a bit of advanced wiring going on beneath the surface. Silvermoon's engineers truly are spell-workers in their own right.

They've been ramping up production lately to help fortify our defenses. Naturally, they look to us for supplies. I have most of the materials they ordered, but I'm low on tin and silver.

Could you help me fulfill the order?
93708.title: Conductive Metals

93709.description:
One can never have too much copper and thorium on hand. Even with all the new miners we brought on, we still nearly deplete our stocks every week.

At this rate, we'll have to start importing--and I do not want the headache that sort of paperwork brings.

If you could help us replenish our stock of copper and thorium, I would be in your debt.
93709.title: Stocking the Staples

93710.description:
The beasts of Quel'Thalas produce leather of unparalleled quality, but the Void has been doing something strange to it.

Normally, we harden leather by heating it under specific conditions. But the darkness clinging to these hides seems to be tempering the leather on its own. I have no idea how this is possible, but we can make use of it.

Bring me as much as you can gather. We have an army to supply.
93710.title: Tempered in Darkness

93711.description:
When we mobilized troops to Northrend many years ago, we had to outfit our soldiers to withstand the icy chill of the frozen wastes. The secret is lining the inside of the armor with fur and plating it securely to trap warmth inside.

We kept detailed records of those techniques. The Void may not be as cold as Northrend, but I'd rather be prepared for the worst.

Bring me a supply of fur and plating and I'll see you compensated.
93711.title: The Chill of the Void

93712.description:
In battle, appearances are nearly as important as raw skill. If you can intimidate your foe before you've even drawn your sword, you're already that much closer to victory.

Our fletchers take this a step further and insist that beautiful feathers make our Farstriders' arrows do more damage. I'm... not certain about that, but I can appreciate the aesthetic.

Here's a list of what they need for this week's batch of arrows. Supply whatever you can and I'll handle the rest.
93712.title: Style and Skill

93713.description:
The Horde's penchant for teeth and animal pelts has worn off on some sin'dorei. It's not uncommon in recent years to receive bulk orders for both.

This is one of those times. If you have any spare hides, or come across any particularly sharp teeth in your hunts, I'd gladly trade you for them.
93713.title: Essential Materials

93714.description:
A well-made suit of scalemail is a sight to behold. It requires quite a bit of patience and attention to fine detail, but Silvermoon's leatherworkers are masters of the craft.

If you happen to hunt any scaled beasts, we could use those materials. A large quantity of smaller sized ones, if you could--they layer more nicely in the armor.
93714.title: Minor Scales

93716.description:
In this game of Decor Duel, one side uses illusion to disguise themselves as, and hide amongst, everyday objects in the area.

The other side uses pre-approved lists of illusion-piercing abilities to find and then capture those hiding cloaked in disguise.

At the end of the round, the teams switch roles, so each side has a chance to hide and seek. 

Time for you to try! This armchair has been enchanted to cloak you with its disguise. Don its appearance, then change your disguise a few times.
93716.title: Learning the Cloaks - Part 1

93717.description:
When disguised, you will have the ability to magically teleport yourself to a nearby piece of decor.

Pick up the chair's disguise again, and this time try swapping your location a few times. Feel free to change your disguise between swaps if you'd like.
93717.title: Learning the Cloaks - Part 2

93719.description:
There are three Seeker classes in Decor Duel, but everyone starts off with the Spellbreaker kit. Don't worry--you can earn access to the others.

Some fundamentals: you can break the shield of a disguised hider's illusion by using Dispel Magic. Once the hider has been marked as Found, you'll have a brief window to Tag them, taking them out of the match.

My statue has been enchanted to outfit you with a Spellbreaker kit. Once outfitted, use Dispel Magic to find and tag decoys hiding around here.
93719.title: Nothing Captured, Nothing Gained

93723.description:
Greetings. Come to lend a hand?

The war effort has been taxing on Silvermoon's resources. We need to keep our soldiers armed and supplied, but even our seasoned crafters have been overwhelmed. To keep up with demand, we have struck a deal with the Artisan's Consortium.

If you have your own skills to offer, speak to Mar'nah. She can help you view and place crafting orders.
93723.title: Crafters Needed

93724.description:
Ah, you're an alchemist?

You should speak with Camberon. He's a skilled alchemist who runs a shop here in Silvermoon.

Camberon has a work table at his shop where you can review, craft, and deliver work orders from public lists and personal contacts like friends and guildmates. If you're lucky, you might come across an order from a renowned person offering a special commission.

Seek him out and see what work is available for you.
93724.title: Crafting Orders: Alchemy

93731.title: Crafting Orders: Leatherworking

93734.description:
Finally we get to see what treasures Groffa was hoarding.

<Furgh's eyes go black as he looks at the bag. The drool on his jowls turns to foam and his claws dig into the sides of the bag as his grip on it tightens.>

Maybe the loa speaker's gifts aren't so bad. We should not be so hasty. I'll take a look. You watch and keep me safe.
93734.title: Precious Trinkets

93745.description:
You have been permitted to range about beneath our Goddess' light. But that doesn't mean we trust you out of hand.

If you wish to prove yourself a friend to the haranir, make yourself useful in Har'athir. It is there that we make the paints for our murals and watch over the newest roots to seek the Goddess' light.
93745.title: Har'athir, Village of Memory

93751.description:
Former home of the Windrunners... now desecrated beyond thought. Since the Scourge invasion, the spire houses our greatest nightmares: banshees, abominations, hateful spirits.

There is no redeeming such a place, but perhaps we may help lay the tormented to rest.
93751.title: Windrunner Spire

93752.description:
I've always disagreed with Lor'themar about the existence of Murder Row. But I guess like any forest, a city should and will have its secrets.

Though recently, Lor'themar has expressed concern about rising fel activity in the area. With the majority of Silvermoon's watch on the Voidstorm, many folks are testing boundaries, taking advantage, making a play for power...

You have my permission to investigate and crush any such illegal activities.
93752.title: Murder Row

93753.description:
Powerful monsters of the void have taken over Magister's Terrace! These halls contain untold amounts of knowledge and arcane power. We cannot lose any of it to our enemy.

Clear the voidspawns and their masters. You'll likely have to solve the terrace's defenses as well, which are designed to prevent and shutdown unauthorized access at any cost.
93753.title: Magisters' Terrace

93754.description:
While Lady Liadrin was in Zul'Aman, she took note of one tribe, the Vilebranch, brutalizing the other forest trolls and their loa. They live up to their name by wanton use of necromancy.

Enter their caverns and put a stop to their black magic!
93754.title: Maisara Caverns

93755.description:
A trial of skill and strength... I'd go myself if I wasn't needed in Silvermoon.

Good luck, champion. I look forward to hearing about your victory against the Amani Loa of War.
93755.title: Den of Nalorakk

93756.description:
This place in Harandar is the Lightbloom's epicenter. Orweyna did what she could, which was much, but we must strike at the taproot of all roots for the plant to die.

Be on your guard, even if you think yourself experienced with the Lightbloom by now. The vale is different from the rampant, but ultimately wild growth in Eversong. It's a calculated force of nature led by a Rootwarden who seeks to strangle you and everything else it desires.
93756.title: The Blinding Vale

93757.description:
If I didn't know that the domanaar thirst for battle, and all the pain and strife that comes with it, I'd say this is trap. Either way, I suppose it's an invitation to get yourself killed.

If you insist on participating in the Void's fighting games, I can't stop you. Just don't hesitate to kill as many voidspawn as possible while you're there, okay?
93757.title: Voidscar Arena

93758.description:
We must continue to keep an eye on this overpowered facility. If breached, disaster will spread beyond the Voidstorm. Unfortunately this magical and mechanical complex is beyond my area of expertise.

Prepare yourself, and ensure that the Nexus-Point Xenas remains dormant.
93758.title: Nexus-Point Xenas

93766.description:
The Void seeks to divide us, to drive a wedge between kin and kingdom alike. We cannot allow it.

Everywhere I turn, I hear of those struggling--families displaced, defenders overwhelmed, healers stretched thin. No blade nor spell alone will turn this tide, but the strength of many hearts united can.

Go forth and lend your aid where it is needed most.
93766.title: Midnight: World Quests

93767.description:
The Arcantina welcomes all who seek respite.

Step inside its lively halls, share a brew, and trade stories with friends old and new.

Where the Void brings chill and silence, here you'll find warmth, laughter, and the spark of fellowship.
93767.title: Midnight: Arcantina

93769.description:
A strong community is built not by walls, but by the hands and hearts of those within it. 

Lend your voice, your time, and your spirit to the neighborhood. Help your fellows, share in their burdens, and take your place as an active part of the home we build together.
93769.title: Midnight: Housing

93771.description:
All waters in Harandar are sacred. They feed the roots of the world and Aln'hara's myriad creations in equal measure. Perhaps none are more spectacular than those that fall from the roots of the tree called Nordrassil.

To the north, you will find Har'kuai. The rains that fall from the sky there carry a remarkable vitality. If you wish to witness all of Aln'hara's majesties, then a trek to Har'kuai would serve you well.
93771.title: Har'kuai, Village of Rain

93774.description:
Aethas Sunreaver, Riftblade Maella, and Auric Sunchaser have recently revitalized an old arcane twist on hide and seek called Decor Duel.

They're looking for new participants to help spread the entertainment.

You should meet them over in Falconwing Square.
93774.title: When is a Chair not for Sitting?

93775.description:
Ah! The outsider who saved Har'mara. Word travels fast through Aln'hara's roots. No doubt Elder Hagar was grateful for your aid.

She would never admit it, but things have been difficult since the roots above her village burned. The rutaani and fungarians each grow bolder in their eccentricities. And the lingering flare-ups on Teldrassil's roots present a constant threat.

If your travels afford another trip to Har'mara, I do not doubt she would benefit from additional help.
93775.title: Har'mara, Village of Balance

93776.description:
Our efforts in the Blinding Bloom have halted the Lightbloom's encroachment for now. But with Rootwarden Ruia gone, there are scarce few who remain to handle the rest of the village's troubles.

I'm going back to Har'alnor to help out where I can. If you have the time and the inclination, your further assistance would be most appreciated.
93776.title: Har'alnor, Village of Twilight

93782.description:
I be sent out here ta prove dat I can be an amani warrior.

Dis trial needs me ta collect as many trophies from dese gnarldin as possible. 

De two of us should work together! I be helpin' you get recognized as an amani warrior, yeah?

Just go out dere and get as many trophies from de gnarldin as possible. 

I be stayin' behind ta watch our backs, eh?
93782.title: Conditional - Multiple Objectives, Sequenced

93783.description:
I be sent out here ta prove dat I can be an amani warrior.

Dis trial needs me ta collect as many trophies from dese gnarldin as possible. 

De two of us should work together! I be helpin' you get recognized as an amani warrior, yeah?

Just go out dere and get as many trophies from de gnarldin as possible. 

I be stayin' behind ta watch our backs, eh?
93783.title: Conditional - Just One Objective

93784.description: <The artifact crumbles in your hand, leaving only a faint but distinctly ancient arcane footprint. Naleidea Rivergleam will want to hear about this.>
93784.title: A Gnawing Void of Curiosity

93792.description:
My name is Du'gal. And you are hash'ura.

Kinduru has ordered me to train you in de ways of loa worship. Take honor in it. Very few gokinye have earned de right as you have.

Beside me is de Altar of Blessings. You may use it to worship any of our loa, and you shall receive a sliver of power in thanks.

Go ahead now, if ya be so kind.
93792.title: Blessings of the Loa

93801.description:
This pathogen is spreading rapidly among the denizens of the Molt.

A swarm of netherwasp hatched shortly after our arrival. The infection spread throughout the region as they fought over territory. If their numbers continue to grow, they could carry the pathogen to the rest of Voidstorm.

{name}, can I ask you to reduce the number of infected creatures in the Molt?
93801.title: Calculated Culling

93810.description:
Not every creature of the Void serves Xal'atath's whims. Conquest was our way long before her arrival.

To the north, you find Slayer's Rise. It is the vast battleground where three domanaar vie for power. And I hear your ren'dorei allies have set up in Masters' Perch, the main citadel, as well.

I am certain great battles await you there. Go forth.
93810.title: Masters' Perch

93816.description:
You have the basics now. All that's left is to experience the Arcane Propagator for yourself in a match of Decor Duel!

What is the Arcane Propagator, you ask? A mystic relic wrought from glamours. It lets players cloak themselves in the guise of enchanted objects.

We've partially recreated it with the chair for training, as you've seen, but the real thing is much better. Why not play a match for real right now?
93816.title: Putting it Together

93841.description:
I was at de Ring of Glory earlier. Have you been? De place is crawlin' with spirits and one of dem gave me quite de fright! Came right up and tried to talk to me! I was too nervous to stick 'round and find out what he wanted.

You look brave and strong. Maybe you oughta check it out.
93841.title: Ghosts of the Ring

93842.description:
My time is runnin' out and I need to see if I can rescue my beloved, Eshaye. She's stuck in de loop, and I want to break her from de cycle before I fade entirely.

I used to be able to get through to her with bouquets of sweetsaw blooms. I can't grasp dem anymore, though. Will you gather some for me?
93842.title: Bloom and Fade

93843.description:
Up near de Ring of Glory, there are spirits like myself who are merchants. Dey sell a variety of things to other spirits, but I got Eshaye's attention in de past using a beverage from Mab'jul.

De market goods can be purchased with ectoplasm, which can be gathered from de frayed spirits around de Ring. Especially de cultists, who steal it from de others.
93843.title: Ectoplasmic Extractions

93849.description:
Eshaye is sure to love these flowers! Now all we need is de spectral brew. Take de ectoplasm to Mab'jul and exchange it for a bottle of spectral brew.

It's a vintage made from harvested ectoplasm, and is quite refreshing. It sometimes has de ability to stall fraying.
93849.title: Ectoplasmic Emporium

93850.description:
So much grief... So much pain. It binds us to this place.

His melodies once soothed us, but now they are drowned out by the din of violence.

Please help us. Follow the sound of the lyre. He will guide you.
93850.title: Windrunner Spire: Haunting Melodies

93851.description:
Dat was a long shot, but I still wanted to try.

<He pauses a moment and shudders, seeming to flicker at the edges.>

I am out of ideas, {name}. Will you ask around? Some of de others here may have some ideas of how to get through to Eshaye. I am not welcome too close to dem, or I would come with you.
93851.title: Communing with Ghosts

93852.description:
The flightstone glimmers with the colors of all aspects. Within the glittering light you have visions of noble dragon houses locked in battle against Primal Incarnates. A vicious cacophony of roars as Shadowflame consumes swaths of land. And the soothing sounds of nature as a world tree blooms.

The soaring skies of Valdrakken call.
93852.title: Lost Iridescent Flightstone

93865.description:
We permit the presence of your kind for one reason. Your willingness to fight. Show us the skills of mortal duelists.

Go, find others of your kind. The pit below is an ideal site for demonstrations of combat prowess.
93865.title: Carve Your Way

93870.description:
The deeds of today becomes the tales of dusk!

Seekers and Hiders, alike, make their mark through thrilling game play and strategic out maneuvering.

The sun shines its light on a new day, shattering the illusions of yesterday, and elongating the shadows of today. Are you ready?

Don you disguise, secure your kit, and show your peers no one can hold a candle to you ... literally!
93870.title: The Ephemeron Masquerade

93877.description:
{name}! Glad to see you. The defenders in the fortress could use your help.

One of the gnomes built a robot to try to help defend the keep. However, it goes haywire every time it turns on.

She needs the help of someone who can properly disrupt the robot's attacks so it can be repaired.

Do you have a moment to help?
93877.title: Conditional Objectives - Sequential

93878.description:
{name}! Glad to see you. The defenders in the fortress could use your help.

One of the gnomes built a robot to try to help defend the keep. However, it goes haywire every time it turns on.

She needs the help of someone who can properly disrupt the robot's attacks so it can be repaired.

Do you have a moment to help?
93878.title: Conditional Objectives - Multiple Steps, No Sequence

93879.description:
{name}! Glad to see you. The defenders in the fortress could use your help.

One of the gnomes built a robot to try to help defend the keep. However, it goes haywire every time it turns on.

She needs the help of someone who can properly disrupt the robot's attacks so it can be repaired.

Do you have a moment to help?
93879.title: Conditional Objectives - Conditional After Sequence

93889.description:
Champion, you would do well to attend Saltheril's Soiree.

There, amidst Silvermoon's intricate politics and quiet struggles for influence, our most distinguished military orders each have matters they wish to see addressed.

Prove your worth to these factions, and you may find their gratitude and favor richly rewarded.
93889.title: Midnight: Saltheril's Soiree

93890.description:
The trolls of Zul'Aman draw their strength from the loa: ancient spirits that grant power to those who honor them. These boons can be wondrous or perilous, depending on the loa's nature and the devotion of its followers.

There are whispers of a Loa of Abundance dwelling within Zul'Aman, its blessings said to bring prosperity to those deemed worthy.

Seek it out, learn what drives it, and see if its favor would serve our cause.
93890.title: Midnight: Abundance

93892.description:
The fight against Xal'atath tests our resolve, but it will not break us.

Void anomalies twist the halls of Stormarion Citadel, but they will find no weakness here. The Void Elves stand as our allies. Prove to our enemies that our strength when united is beyond the reach of even the Void.

Go, {name}--aid them, and see the Citadel cleansed of corruption.
93892.title: Midnight: Stormarion Assault

93897.description: There's a holiday celebration goin' on at yer neighborhood! Get yerself back home and check it out.
93897.title: Home for the Holidays

93898.description: I've heard tell of spooky apparitions and tasty treats popping up around the neighborhoods. If ye get a chance, you may want to look into it.
93898.title: A Haunted Home

93899.description: We've received reports of escalated troubles between some domanaar. Go investigate the battle in Slayer's Rise, then report to Deminos Darktrance in Masters' Perch.
93899.title: Slayer's Rise

93906.description:
It never occurred to me to attack Eshaye. I been wasting time tryin' to get her to talk to me, without knowin' how to talk to her.

Will you do dis for me? Challenge Eshaye and beat her. Could dis wake her up? I feel hope stirrin'.
93906.title: Untethering the Two

93907.description:
When you acquire a new Seeker kit, it always starts off relatively lean.

But you'll earn Illusionary Coins as you play, and may trade them in with Gamemaster Fleurian for expanded abilities, and even additional kits!

Take these. Add them to what you earned and demonstrate your shopping prowess.
93907.title: Edification of the Worthy

93909.description:
Many have ventured into the delves' depths, but few have returned with more than dust and bruises.

Valeera Sanguinar has taken a keen interest in these ventures. She leaves no stone unturned and has a remarkable talent for getting in to places others cannot.

Seek her out, and see what fortune or danger awaits beneath the surface.
93909.title: Midnight: Delves

93910.description:
Silvermoon is beset on all sides by threats both known and unknown. There are those who seek to track these threats and put an end to the strife and chaos they create.

Speak with Magister Astalor Bloodsworn in Murder Row. He will guide you toward the urgent threats.
93910.title: Midnight: Prey

93911.description:
The dungeons of Azeroth hold great challenges and even greater rewards. Within them lay treasures that may aid you in battles yet to pass, and powerful foes to overcome.

Enter the dungeon, and see what awaits you there.
93911.title: Midnight: Dungeons

93912.description:
Gather your allies, you will face the great trials ahead. 

The rewards are vast, and can aid you in the battles ahead. You and your allies need only vanquish a small number of these terrible foes.
93912.title: Midnight: Raid

93913.description:
Powerful enemies roam Azeroth, their strength growing with each passing battle.

Only through courage and unity will you emerge victorious.
93913.title: Midnight: World Boss

93929.description:
<A parchment reaches you from an unknown sender.>

<It speaks of perusing a tome to catch up on current events, and how it is vital to understand a looming threat.>

<Perhaps you should seek out this tome to understand more when you are ready.>
93929.title: The War Within Recap

93942.description:
A vision of radiance permeates your mind.

Eldara Dawnrunner might have more information regarding these Sparks of Radiance.
93942.title: Spark of Radiance

93943.description: <You hold the curio and discover a shimmering glow emanating from it. This looks important.>
93943.title: Ancient Curiosity: Combat

93945.description: <You hold the curio and discover a shimmering glow emanating from it. This looks important.>
93945.title: Ancient Curiosity: Utility

93965.description:
Seems like you've got the spurs for this ride. Just takes a little gettin' used to is all.

Critters of all kind are crawling around Eversong and beyond. Cute, cuddly, creepy--whatever strikes your fancy.

You look tough enough to nab your own. Why don't ya give it a try?
93965.title: Pet Wranglin'

93969.description:
Critters of all kind are crawling around Eversong and beyond. Cute, cuddly, creepy--whatever strikes your fancy.

Ya might be used to havin' varmints bash heads until one was weak enough to nab. Got a new way to try. All you need is a crate. You've got one, yeah?

Just throw the crate from the start. It's mighty effective, I tell ya.

You look tough enough to nab your own. Why don't ya give it a try?
93969.title: Call Shot

93970.description:
The urgent nature of our mission to these lands should not preclude us from embarking on new and meaningful research. Long have my people studied the void, and any opportunity to break new ground must be seized. 

Our scouts have been finding peculiar void manifestations throughout Voidstorm. If my hypothesis is correct, I believe we can use our host's facilities to further refine and understand these samples.
93970.title: Researching the Storm

93979.description:
Dimensius threatens us once more. There is no one who knows his methods better than his former Harbinger, Xal'atath. I would not say we can trust her, but we can work with her. She fears the All-Devouring's wrath after her betrayal.

We can't afford to turn away any potential ally. Think how many we will save from the Void Lord's hunger. Get your bearings in this city the four of us saved together. I will convince Alleria.
93979.title: Lingering Memories

93997.description:
Vidious is moving to claim Slayer's Rise, sending his proxies to occupy the Void Posts. I shall not be outmaneuvered.

Seize full control of each of the Void Posts and eliminate any of Vidious's forces that try to stop you.
93997.title: Void Post Control

93998.description:
Oi! You there!

Have you seen those big shiny trees in the neighborhood? Yeah, well, some nasty little creatures keep popping up to burn them down or nick the goodies. Unacceptable! That trees are under official goblin protection!

So here's the deal: I need you to get rid of those creatures when they appear. Punt em, fling em, smash em, I don't care, whatever you have to do to protect the tree.

I've set up some practice dummies for you to get the hang of things.
93998.title: Guardian of the Tree

93999.description:
Ziadan vies for control of Slayer's Rise, sending her proxies out to seize the Void Posts. Show her two can play at this game.

Strike quickly: seize control of the Void Posts, slaying any who stand in your way.
93999.title: Void Post Control

94012.description:
Howdy, pardner. Folks at this here pet store asked for my help straighten' out this place. But while I was distracted, a hawkstrider chick I've been rearin' slipped out the front door. Prettiest purple plumes you ever did see.

Would you do me the kindness of finding her and bringing her back for me? I take her for a stroll in the garden every so often. I'll betcha that's where you'll find her.
94012.title: Lost Lil' Strider

94031.description:
Do you have time to break a curse, {class}?

I'm what remains of a loa speaker of Gral. I kept de prisoners in line on Gral's Belly. But we crashed, I died, and de prisoners escaped.

My powers didn't work on de livin' anymore. But they did work on de captain, who'd died with me.

Terrified of his anger at my failure, I set up a ritual to trap him in de ship using my own bones.

My soul has leeched into de bones after all this time, and now I can't move them. Would you bring my bones to me?
94031.title: Bones of My Soul

94035.description:
To move my soul out o' de bones and into me, I need to do a ritual.

Gral is de loa of many things, but mostly de sea. He's a shark. And he likes meat!

Get meat from de sea creatures around here. It will be easier to perform de ritual with somethin' red and oozing to ground me.
94035.title: Meat for the Bones

94036.description:
I cannot pretend I am any better than de captain.

We both enjoyed lording our power over de prisoners. When he'd lash out, I did not stop him.

But in our time trapped here together, I've reflected. De minute I wasn't useful to him, he got angry. And now I want this to end.

I cannot enable him any more. Would you put him to rest?
94036.title: One Final Prisoner

94040.description:
We have everything we need for de ritual.

Meet me at de Tooth o' Sargoth. You'll help me get my soul back in one piece, then this curse will finally be over.

May Gral judge me on de other side for my failures here.
94040.title: Meat and Bone and Soul

94052.description:
If I am to defeat Ziadan, I need information.

Maps, strategy scrolls, battle reports, anything that gives me an edge!

Scour the Hate Spire and nearby grounds. Search every chest and cut down guards to find the information I need.
94052.title: The Domanaar's Plan

94055.description:
To counter Vidious' foul plans, I need information.

Maps, strategy scrolls, battle reports, anything that turns the battle in my favor!

Scour the Grief Spire and nearby grounds. Search every chest and cut down guards to find the information I need.
94055.title: The Domanaar's Plan

94056.description:
A unique and valuable gift has been sent to me, hidden in the supply crates that drop upon Slayer's Rise. 

Should Ziadan obtain this gift instead, her insufferable gloating would never cease!

Enter War Mode, and seize control of a supply crate. Then recover the gift for me!
94056.title: A Golden Pull

94057.description:
A unique and valuable gift has been sent to me, hidden in the supply crates that drop upon Slayer's Rise.

Should Vidious obtain this gift instead, his taunts would be incessant.

Enter War Mode, and seize control of a supply crate. Then recover the gift for me!
94057.title: A Golden Pull

94210.description: A house isn't quite a home without the perfect furnishings. It looked like there were some vendors in town. Perhaps it would be worth checking what they have in stock.
94210.title: Feathering the Nest

94361.description:
You are ready, acolyte! Ready to spread your wings or what have you?

I have projected my presence into today's most active and tumultuous lands, rummaging about their natures and environs for areas ripe with abundance. With a little provocation from me, these forgotten corners are blooming bright with glorious harvestables!

Seek me out! A crypt of phantasms in Eversong! A grove of verdant flora in Harandar! Even a quarry of living rock in Voidstorm! And, of course, right here too!
94361.title: The Abundant Life

94363.description:
If you've found yourself an invite you'll be wanting to put it to good use, no?

Use your Blood-Soaked Invitation first then talk to a Bouncer in the Brawlpub and get to brawling!
94363.title: The Gloves Are Off

94370.description:
Do you bring tidings from Numia? She was supposed to be here and help me assess these fair flowers.

She must be occupied. The naga have encroached on my town and hers... they have kept to the beach so far, but that could change quickly.

Will you check on my friend?
94370.title: Slithering Closer

94371.description:
Apprentices! Who can keep them tied down?

Taemin was a particularly talented arcanist, but his head was always in the clouds. Or in the woods, really.

Instead of studying, he buried his nose in storybooks! The legends of Eversong! The Rangers of old! Heroes of the Sin'dorei! He couldn't get enough, the dreaming fool!

And now... no, he's not dead. Did I imply that?

He's just run off to join the Farstriders. Check in on him, won't you? See if he's come to his senses?
94371.title: A Ranger's Dream

94372.description:
If you've found yourself an invite you'll be wanting to put it to good use, no?

Use your Blood-Soaked Invitation first then talk to a Grunt in the Brawl'gar Arena and get to brawling!
94372.title: The Gloves Are Off

94379.description:
It looks like your house is ready for an upgrade. This doesn't normally happen so fast, but you've really made an impression around here.

Head on over to our general contractor for next steps.
94379.title: This Old Hearth

94380.description:
Pardon the intrusion, {name}!

I'm delivering a summons from Ranger Captain Lilatha. She's requested your presence at her staging grounds overlooking the Bazaar near the north gate of Silvermoon.

Our lands are once again under threat and we'll need all the support we can get.

Report to her when you can!
94380.title: Ranger Captain's Summons

94381.description:
Halduron Brightwing has made sure that our task force is well equipped to handle any threat. I want you to check in with our quartermaster, Maren Silverwing. She will help you get outfitted. 

I also want you to talk with our "liaison." She is the troll with the guards. You may already know we are not alone in being targeted. 

Brightwing has reminded us that these enemies do not respect borders, so threats to Zul'Aman require our attention just as much as Eversong. We must deal with the troll.
94381.title: Outfitting and Allies

94382.description:
To get right to it, I have laid out some lessons and some scout objectives for us as we approach the various dangers we might see in these ritual sites.

I have also marked on your map the location of one of these rituals. Take care, as the magics we have seen woven at these sites can overwhelm even the most stalwart warrior.
94382.title: Ritual Problems

94383.description:
I am here at the behest of the great Zul'jarra! May she lead her people to greatness.

We face dire threats. Your Captain General is focused on the martial stakes, but the terrible magics unleashed recently pose an even greater danger. Our scouts have discovered rituals that risk ruin for us all.

Your Ranger Captain has recruited the Lady Darkglen, who appears to be a knowledgeable and capable ritual expert.

Seek her out in the tent nearby to find out how best to approach these ritual sites.
94383.title: Ritual Interest

94384.description:
This is not my first ritual. 

I have created a diagram that should help us approach and counter these rituals. You have gained valuable Field Research, now we need to put it to use. 

I have created a Research Diagram for you. It will enable powerful boons for you to use and counter the various challenges you will find in a Ritual Site.
94384.title: Ritual Studies

94385.description: We are seeing a Void Assault in Eversong. We need you to head out immediately to counter these threats. I will mark the strikes on your map as our scouts identify them and direct your efforts from here.
94385.title: Void Assaults: Eversong Woods

94386.description:
My scouts report a Void Assault in Zul'Aman. We need your help to counter these threats. 

I will direct you, and my scouts will continue to mark new activities on your map.
94386.title: Void Assaults: Zul'Aman

94388.description:
A little lesson. Trying to fool me twice is a grave error.

My dim-witted pupil has yet to return from their rendezvous with their acquaintance. Normally I would not bat an eye, but he has a journal of mine. I want that journal back.

Would you be a dear and remind him?
94388.title: Second Time's a Choice

94393.description:
How good are you at teaching, {name}?

One of my pupils, Kyltus, has been having particular trouble with deciding what path along the road of life he wants to pursue. 

Perhaps a talk with you will aid his tumultuous heart?
94393.title: Career Counseling

94396.description:
There seems to be a problem student at the academy.

I have heard reports that a student, Tytalor Goldenblade, is stirring up trouble in Sunstrider Isle. I'd go myself but I have my hands full running practice here already.

Could you go check on him and... educate him of his misgivings?
94396.title: Down a Peg

94402.description:
Ziadan has allied with some of the most die-hard Horde champions. The kind who despise peace and fight on whenever and wherever possible.

Show them that Vidious also commands mighty champions!
94402.title: Old War Grudge

94403.description:
Vidious has allied with some of the  most die-hard Alliance champions. The kind who despise peace and fight on whenever and wherever possible.

Show them that Ziadan also commands mighty champions!
94403.title: Old War Grudge

94408.description:
It is not honor or glory that drives your kind to war...it is gold. You and your enemies are always paid for the blood you spill upon the battlefield.

Every enemy you slay in Slayer's Rise carries a contract from Ziadan. Bring me those contracts, and I will pay you what their loyalty once cost her.
94408.title: Contract of Service

94409.description:
It is not honor or glory that drives your kind to war...it is gold. You and your enemies are always paid for the blood you spill upon the battlefield.

Every enemy you slay in Slayer's Rise carries a contract from Vidious. Bring me those contracts, and I will pay you what their loyalty once cost her
94409.title: Contract of Service

94417.description:
Using what I've learned from Silvermoon's artisans, Cuzolth and I can infuse your gear with additional power!

Powerful equipment requires Dawncrests to upgrade it to its full potential. These crests are rewarded through many different activities. Dawncrests have five tiers, and more dangerous tasks reward you with higher-tier crests. Adventurer Dawncrests are the lowest tier, but still quite powerful!

Bring me thirty Adventurer Dawncrests and we can help you upgrade your gear further.
94417.title: Crests of the Dawn

94418.description:
Did you know that crests can be transmuted into different tiers?

If you find yourself with crests that are too powerful for the gear you've acquired, I can help you transmute those crests into lower tiers that you can use.

And once all of your gear is sufficiently powerful, I'll be able to transmute your spare lower crests into higher ones!

Let's practice the transmutation process. Here's a few Veteran Dawncrests. Speak to me and I can transform them into Adventurer Dawncrests for you.
94418.title: Crest Transmutation

94423.description:
Our control here is only the beginning. Xal'atath has left other pockets of anomalies across the land. The defenses we've devised here can be used to secure those areas as well.

Travel to Sunkiller Sanctum and construct five additional defenses to solidify our hold on that location.

I will supply the Stormarion Core necessary to activate those defenses.
94423.title: Sanctum Secure

94430.description:
{name}, you're just in time! I was exchanging research notes with the artisans here in Silvermoon all day. Did you know they can infuse weapons and armor with the power of the dawn itself? Fascinating!

I've been itching to put some of these new techniques to the test. Bring me a piece of Adventurer equipment and I'll let you know what we need to make it more powerful.

There should be plenty of people in Silvermoon and beyond willing to reward you with some Adventurer equipment in exchange for your aid.
94430.title: Adventuring Gear

94432.description:
We have only just begun to scratch the surface of how powerful your gear can become!

However, every piece of equipment has a limit to how much it can be upgraded. The more powerful an item is at its baseline, the more powerful it will become as we upgrade it. An item's upgrade track determines which crests we must use to upgrade it.

Bring me a piece of Veteran equipment this time along with some Veteran Dawncrests. Just like before, Cuzolth will help you upgrade the item using those crests.
94432.title: Veteran Equipment

94444.description:
Hi. I'm Ambassador Blackguard.

I am honored to welcome you to Orgrimmar, {race}.

<He smiles unconvincingly.>

As a lifetime of adventure unfolds before you, be assured that... uh...

You know what? I've been saying this same greeting all day. Enough's enough.

Talk to Chromie on top of the hourglass, then talk to your emissary. Run along.
94444.title: Choose a Path

94445.description:
Welcome to Stormwind, {race}. I invite you to explore our fair city. Say, you look like someone who appreciates the great outdoors! Elwynn is lovely this time of year.

Ah, but that can wait, a bronze dragon has asked to talk to you. She is sitting under the nearby tree, on an hourglass of all things!

After that, an emissary of yours is waiting to welcome you to the city. Sounds like a busy day for you!

Have a pleasant stay, {name}!
94445.title: Choose a Path

94446.description:
Excellent work so far, {name}. 

But there is always more to be done.

Go out and hunt the most powerful targets available to us with all the fury our magic has to offer.
94446.title: A Nightmarish Task

94447.description:
Zawadi safe, eh? Good. No harm should come to her. We need to deal with these oversized worms.

Just over there, by de beach, is one of their broodmothers. Vile creature! Responsible for all de eggs you see 'round here. Kill her. Their invasion will stall, giving my people more time to organize a strike.

I need to tend my wounds. I will hide and wait for you.
94447.title: Ophidia the Broodmother

94450.description:
We're still getting things setup for rewarding endeavors. This is a temporary quest to grant you community coupons.

Community Coupons will normally be earned by completing endeavor tasks, not via a quest like this.
94450.title: Twenty Five Percent Completed

94451.description:
We're still getting things setup for rewarding endeavors. This is a temporary quest to grant you community coupons. 

Community Coupons will normally be earned by completing endeavor tasks, not via a quest like this.
94451.title: Fifty Percent Completed

94452.description:
We're still getting things setup for rewarding endeavors. This is a temporary quest to grant you community coupons. 

Community Coupons will normally be earned by completing endeavor tasks, not via a quest like this.
94452.title: Seventy Five Percent Completed

94453.description:
We're still getting things setup for rewarding endeavors. This is a temporary quest to grant you community coupons. 

Community Coupons will normally be earned by completing endeavor tasks, not via a quest like this.
94453.title: One Hundred Percent Completed

94455.description: It's time to cross the threshold into a new chapter.
94455.title: Home at Last

94457.description:
Battlegrounds stand as crucible where soldiers clash for honor, resources, and glory.

Each victory hones your skill and strengthens your resolve.

Go, test yourself against worthy foes and bring pride to your banner.
94457.title: Midnight: Battlegrounds

94464.description:
You have travelled far and learned much of Aln'hara's grace.

It is time to return home and share the wisdom you have earned with your people.
94464.title: Heritage of the Haranir

94474.description:
In wake of recent events, the Vanguard of the Light has recovered and preserved relics of exceptional power and craftsmanship. To safeguard these treasures from prying eyes, the Magisters of Silvermoon have conjured a vault within Silvermoon's bank.

Only the most proven of champions may earn the right to draw from its splendor. If the Light deems you worthy, you may be bestowed an artifact of great power.
94474.title: The Great Vault

94475.description:
There's little light in these lands. What remains is fractured, hidden, or fading.

Fetch me Echoes of Radiance and I will grant you passage where no path should exist.
94475.title: The Voidspire: Flicker in the Hollow

94476.description:
There's little light in these lands. What remains is fractured, hidden, or fading.

Fetch me Echoes of Radiance and I will grant you passage where no path should exist.
94476.title: The Voidspire: Flicker in the Hollow

94477.description:
There's little light in these lands. What remains is fractured, hidden, or fading.

Fetch me Echoes of Radiance and I will grant you passage where no path should exist.
94477.title: The Voidspire: Flicker in the Hollow

94519.description:
Ever since the terrible events of the Voidspire, Arator has suffered. He has kept to himself, or prayed alone at the Dawnwell.

We all feel the loss of Alleria and Turalyon, but Arator only reunited with them recently, after their long fight against the Burning Legion.

I worry that if he is left to his own thoughts for too long, he may not come out of this the same.

Let us go to the Dawnwell and check on him.
94519.title: What Hope in the Light?

94520.description:
While we cannot know yet where Xal'atath has gone, or if Alleria and Turalyon are still alive, we can still pursue information.

Riftblade Maella has kept me up to date on the Twilight cultists. They have been gathering strength, gathering numbers, and seem to be searching for... something. Now is the time to act.

Let us travel to the Ruins of Deatholme and see why the cultists there have reinvigorated themselves.
94520.title: Resurgence in Deatholme

94521.description:
The information we need has to be here! We just need to get it from the Twilight's Blade.

There's nothing wrong with the direct method. Apply force, and see what you can learn.

I brought Benthar's Scarlet Spire, the relic we rescued from the Scarlet Crusade. It's already been used to help protect the Sunwell, and maybe it can help us here.
94521.title: The Direct Method

94522.description:
An organization as widespread and diverse as the Twilight's Blade must need to write down their objectives.

Or at the least, whatever they have collected should shed light on what they're up to. 

See if you can find anything that points to their current direction.
94522.title: They Always Write It Down

94523.description:
Oh, please don't hurt me!

<The pathetic voidling cowers at the sight of you.>

It's not my fault. I could have gotten them out of this.

It's those new commanders! They have led the Twilight cult down the wrong path.

Glaivh is the worst of them. If he was gone, perhaps, perhaps...
94523.title: My Poor Beautiful Self

94524.description:
The rank-and-file Twilight's Blade didn't have much to tell us, but their new leadership may know more.

You've already bested one of them. Let's see if there are others who also aspire to lead, and learn what they know.

You can still use the Scarlet Spire on them. If Umbric won't use his magic, then perhaps the Light will make them talk.

They should be below us, in the chasm.
94524.title: Under New Management

94525.description:
No one notices a creature like me...

No one appreciates how much I have lost.

But in that underestimation... knowledge.

Help me regain some strength, and I will regain the words you need.
94525.title: A Comeback Story

94526.description:
As soon as we met that little voidling, I thought there was something I recognized. 

How Antenorian survived, I know not. But it's clear that we cannot let him get away. We need to know what he knows, and then his time on Azeroth should truly be ended.

Come, let's get what we need and finish this.
94526.title: Verifiably Untrustworthy

94527.description:
Arator jumped after Antenorian like a man possessed. He's so blinded by this crusade, he... he must not know how dangerous it is for someone like him to simply leap into the Void blindly.

No, we must think calmly about this. Analyze the situation.

We have no way of knowing what's on the other side of that portal. 

But we must go in. We must find Arator.
94527.title: Null Space

94528.description:
I need a moment, after what we just went through. I feel like my body is fighting with itself.

But we're in hostile territory. I can't let us fall to enemies just because I was... because I had to jump in after him. We need to keep Umbric safe.

Can you clear out the Twilight's Blade around us to give us some room to recover?
94528.title: Carving Out Room

94529.description:
We are lucky to have survived that tear through the Void, but now we are presented with an opportunity.

Antenorian must have been going somewhere in this direction, which is why we find ourselves no longer in Eversong. But we interrupted his journey, and he is still here somewhere.

I can feel it like a chill along my spine.

See if you can find any more information from the Twilight's Blade here. What of that gateway that Antenorian spoke of? What of those Amani prophecies?
94529.title: A Dark Shadow Looms

94530.description:
I've been able to trace where Antenorian fled. He is more powerful than he was before, after that jaunt through the void space. 

Fortunately, this makes him easy to track. He's below us, in an open cavity underground. I can open a portal there.

<Umbric glances over at Arator.>

I hope that we can put an end to this, and Arator is no worse for wear. When we started this, I thought we would find a few scrolls, uncover their plan, and put a stop to it ourselves.

I did not anticipate this.
94530.title: The Call of the Void

94531.description:
<Arator quietly seethes.>

We need to tell Lor'themar what we've learned. Not because I want to stop looking for Xal'atath, but this is important.

Come, let's leave Zul'Aman and return to Silvermoon.
94531.title: Like Mother, Like Son

94582.description: [PH] Go and aid Dundun, the Loa of Abundance, in harvesting the land's resources!
94582.title: [PH] Abundant Power

94622.description:
The Trial of Style gives us the opportunity to look good, {class}.

The camera makes sure we keep looking good. 

So focus on me and my camera, follow my directions and I'll make sure you look fantastic!
94622.title: Work It

94623.description:
I have been considering how I may offer you greater strength, my friend. I've come up with something, but I need your help building a proper Voidforge.

What? Oh, fear not, all my ulterior motives are still aligned with your cause. For now.

To begin, I need one Elementary Voidcore. You will be able to find shards from the more powerful foes you habitually encounter. Inflict your usual violence, return the shards, and I can weave them back into a true Voidcore to serve as the forge's foundation.
94623.title: Building the Voidforge
