94675.description:
As ever, your persistence is admirable.

It's time to put the finishing touches on the Voidforge, and then the real work can begin.
94675.title: Voidforge Reforged

94677.description:
Something keeps troubling me about this, {name}. Where is the Rootwarden?

Ruia has a solemn duty to watch over the World Tree and the land around it. He should be here, with his people in need. So where could he be when they are in crisis? What is he thinking?

I am sure that we can find clues to where he has gone if we search his town. Perhaps we can learn more about his state of mind along the way.
94677.title: The Missing Rootwarden

94790.description:
No rest for the researchers, as they say.

As much as I would love to go traipsing around this blasted voidscape, I need to remain at this post. But you! You can be our eyes and ears in the abyss.

Go and explore the Voidstorm, maybe we can find some additional samples to feed into the console.
94790.title: Research Console: Exploring the Void

94796.description:
Now that the Hoarder is gone, the fish population has boomed. There's a flood of fish with no curse at all!

Captain Tokka wants to study these curse-resistant fish. Go and collect a few of their livers so we can see what keeps them swimming.

If we want to use the venom-curse for ourselves, we need more cursed fish!
94796.title: Curing Curse Resistance

94798.description:
Captain Tokka finished the lure for Ssak'mozek. It's time to kill the beast!

Take the lure into the marsh, near the wreck of Pa'ku's Talon. Ready yourself, then place it on the rocks there.

Ssak'mozek will be drawn to the lure. Kill it.
94798.title: Ssak'mozek's Desire

94800.description:
Hegvosh the Hoarder is back!

He's already started killing anything that gets in his way. This time, he's stomped on all of our crab traps in the south.

Salvage any working trap pieces you find. We'll need to rebuild them.
94800.title: Crushed Crabs

94802.description:
Ssak'mozek always has three heads. Captain Tokka's lure targets each of them.

The next piece of the lure is ethereal beads from ghosts on the Isle. They exist somewhere between here and the beyond and shine in just the right way that the hydra can't ignore them.

Ye can find some of these beads in the Crypt of the Lost Mason. Be careful--the ghosts may not like you entering that place.
94802.title: Death from the Dead

94803.description:
The final pieces of Captain Tokka's hydra lure are feathers from the Children of Ula'tek themselves.

Ssak'mozek is trained to listen to the orders of these monsters. It lies in wait for them to call it from the murky depths. The lure can't work without something tying it to Ssak'mozek's masters.

Any of the children at the Gate of the Eastern Fang will have feathers perfect for the lure. Bring as many as you can.
94803.title: Going for the Crown

94804.description:
Have you noticed fewer fish on the south side of Atal'Utek lately? That's the Hoarder at work.

He's this big ugly sea giant we can't seem to shake. You'll know you've found him when you see piles of dead fish rotting away.

Make him think twice about taking too much from these waters.
94804.title: A Collection of Rot

94805.description:
The Children of Ula'tek eat venom-cursed fish straight from the water. Now that we've made the fish stronger, the children have gone into a feeding frenzy!

Captain Tokka says to stop the poaching. The children have plenty of venom already!
94805.title: The New Hoard, Poached

94806.description:
Captain Tokka wants us to fish for Ssak'mozek.

The Children of Ula'tek raise a hydra more vicious and venom-cursed than all the rest. We've caught and killed it before, but they always raise another and give it the same name: Ssak'mozek.

We're going to craft one of Tokka's best lures to draw it in.

Start by collecting the legs of leeches. When broken, they have a smell the children and their creations cannot resist.
94806.title: Wriggling and Wet

94831.description:
<The idol appears to be a figure of Ohn'ahra carved from serevite, an ore used in many titan temples.

Preservationist Kathos would surely be interested in this.>
94831.title: An Idol in Hand

94834.description:
<This idol proves the depth of your bond with abundance.

Speak with Du'gal at the Altar of Blessings in Amani'Zar to begin worshipping Dundun.>
94834.title: Blessings of Abundance

94835.description:
Interested in enrolling in a training program? Some of the strongest warriors have emerged from hard work and dedication. 

With some practice, {name}, you surely can join their ranks. Begin today!
94835.title: Early Morning Training

94836.description: Welcome back to this multi-course training - only a few weeks left! Let's put into practice what you learned last week. Go and participate in Battlegrounds in the Training Grounds or against other combatants, then return back to me.
94836.title: Late Night Training: Week 1 of 3

94837.description: You're over half way done with your training! Again, let's take some of the lessons you have learned previously and apply them in the battle fields. Enter Training Grounds or Battlegrounds then return to me.
94837.title: Midnight Training: Week 2 of 3

94838.description: This is the final week of training. Take all of the lessons you've learned and put them into practice in the Training Grounds or against other players. Once complete, speak with Captain Dawnrunner in Falconwing Square.
94838.title: Final Training: Week 3 of 3

94839.description:
<This idol proves the depth of your bond with peril.

Speak with Du'gal at the Altar of Blessings in Amani'Zar to begin worshipping Puul.>
94839.title: Blessings of Peril

94840.description:
<This idol proves the depth of your bond with the Depths.

Speak with Du'gal at the Altar of Blessings in Amani'Zar to begin worshipping Pahk.>
94840.title: Blessings of The Depths

94844.description:
We must repel this attack.

Your Horde is strong. You do not give in to the hypocritical claims of the Alliance. You do not let them besmirch your honor.

I want my forces to learn from you. Go, take this Voidclarion. Use it to inspire my void minions.

Let them see the power of the Horde.
94844.title: Voidscar Arena: For My Horde

94845.description:
Vidious presses an attack. I do not see this Alliance he recruited, but monsters.

Illogical. Vidious would not recruit another force until we had our fun with the recent additions.

Fight these monsters. Find out what they are. Bring me evidence.

Perhaps you need a cause to fight for beyond amusement? If Vidious tires of me, he will turn his conquest to Azeroth next. You'll want to stop that, right?

Then aid me.
94845.title: Voidscar Arena: The Bastion of Might

94847.description:
As you may or may not recall, I once helped young paladins obtain their first armored mount.

It was a tedious task that involved months of obtaining materials and sending them all over Azeroth.

Thankfully, times have changed and we now have most of those materials at hand. That being said, I wish to help you obtain a new mount, something worthy of your title as Highlord.

In order for us to begin, I only require that you obtain a barding for us. Something strong, thick, and heavy.
94847.title: Preparations Underway

94848.description:
Vidious, using shadowgraft? Unbelievable. He is better than this.

How dare he disappoint me.

I need no shadowgraft to convince mighty {class}s like you to fight for me.

Show him the error of his ways before he disappoints me further and abandons this conflict in favor of helping Xal'atath conquer Azeroth.

Take the fight to him. Siege his bastion. And if you do not wish to stain your hands with Alliance blood, there are many void minions awaiting your prowess.
94848.title: Voidscar Arena: Pre-Provoked Violence

94849.description:
Vidious will have a favorite, much like I do: a mortal from your world filled with grief turned to violence.

They do not have the support of your leaders, but they will always have support from us domanaar.

Find this favorite. I hear of a warlock that has slain many Horde. I feel their grief wafting in the air. They are so lost in it, they would give up the war to save Azeroth for a chance to kill your people.

Go. Savor the fight.
94849.title: Voidscar Arena: A Familiar Grudge

94850.description:
If we wish to achieve a sustained connection to Xoroth, we'll need a particularly resilient portal. Unfortunately, we can't just summon this one up from the ground.

I will need you to gather the requisite materials. Once we have them, I will have the mo'arg begin construction at once. 

Here's the list of what you'll need.
94850.title: If You Build It

94855.description:
So, we have another enemy? One who would get in between me and Vidious?

<Ziadan tightens her fist around her weapon.>

Unacceptable.

The Voidscar Arena to the north is the most strategic position outside of our bastions. An interloping domanaar will have staged their forces there, I guarantee it.

I can set aside my quarrel with Vidious long enough to deal with this shared threat. Fortunately for you, he hasn't brought his Alliance forces with him.
94855.title: Voidscar Arena: Setting It Aside

94867.description:
Tolbani and Jehnira have been missin' for some time. Last I heard, dey were scoutin' Atal'Abasi for supplies.

That area is covered in murlocs. Too many of 'em is dangerous even for an Amani.

Find dem and make sure dey alright!
94867.title: Lost in Atal'Abasi

94868.description:
Jan'alai is a hen! And dat means eggs!

De eggs of de loa are volatile! Dey must be hatched carefully. My family carried dis honor for generations, but de tradition died when my older brothers followed de false promises of Zul'jin. Sadly, I am de only brother left, and we need two hatchers for de ritual!

Find my niece, Shaja, down by de shore. She is too young to know de ritual, but de loa's favor flows through her veins as it did my brothers'. It is time for her to know this honor.
94868.title: It Takes Two

94869.description:
We will soon be blessed with eggs! Jan'alai has told me so. And once dem eggs hatch, we'll have many hungry mouths to feed! Dey will crave somethin' soft, delicate, and pungent.

<Brek eyes you up and down.>

Ya best scurry down to de shore and find somethin' to tempt de hatchlings with or dey may take a nibble out of you!

<Brek laughs.>
94869.title: Hungry Hungry Hatchlings

94870.description:
De eggs are nearly ready!

<Brek glances eagerly at both clutches of eggs.>

Ya may know somethin' about dis, eh? Jan'alai tells me so. What ya lack in blood, ya make up for in spirit. Help me teach Shaja! Ya spirit alone is not enough for dis ritual. De eggs are imbued with de power of de loa herself and will burst with fiery energy!

We can protect ya from dis, but first we need feathers. Loa feathers! Collect dem from around de temple... unless ya dare ask de loa herself!
94870.title: Eggstra Protection Never Hurts

94871.description:
Magistrix Landra Dawnstrider has sent a request for aid in dealing with the local Lightbloom. While typically harmless, it has recently begun to grow at an incredible rate.

Meet up with Arator in Fairbreeze Village to investigate the threat and provide what assistance you can.
94871.title: Eversong

94882.description:
All is ready! I will now guide ya both through de hatchin' ceremony!

Talk to Shaja and she will use de feathers to protect ya from dem powerful loa energies.
94882.title: Perfect Timing

94883.description:
I know my uncle can seem... off at times. His talk of de loa always felt like childhood stories to me.

But ever since Jan'alai returned, I feel her energy too! She flickers, she smolders, she burns red hot. She also brings warmth, light, and life!

But what I feel from her right now is distress--dat of a mother hen counting her chicks but comin' up short.

Let's check on de hatchlings. We can cover more ground if we split up.
94883.title: Like Dragonhawks to a Flame

94909.description:
<This idol proves the depth of your bond with pestilence.

Speak with Du'gal at the Altar of Blessings in Amani'Zar to begin worshipping Mot'amra.>
94909.title: Blessings of Pestilence

94910.description:
<This idol proves the depth of your bond with growth.

Speak with Du'gal at the Altar of Blessings in Amani'Zar to begin worshipping Oe.>
94910.title: Blessings of Growth

94920.description:
<The Hal'hadar battery core has been damaged, exposing its inner workings.

Amidst the thin energy wires and familiar metalwork seen in K'areshi technology, you spot gleaming yellow crystals fitted into a golden frame. Small runic letters on the metal are inscribed under it.

Perhaps one of the ethereals in the Howling Ridge in the Voidstorm could help identify this.>
94920.title: Hal'hadar Battery Core

94932.description:
With Thunderaan risen again as the lord of Skywall, there may indeed be an arrangement you can make in exchange for those wretched implements. But one binding is of no use on its own.

Return to me with both bindings, and with powerful enough ore to bind them, and I will arrange your audience with Thunderaan the Windlord.
94932.title: Bindings of the Windlord

94933.description:
Ah, you're there!

Our esteemed Magister Umbric has tasked me with wrangling an able-bodied champion to assist him. An apprentice of his, Leona Darkstrider, is investigating the techniques and methods of the illidari.

It appears her inquiries may have put her in a bit of trouble.

The Magister can fill you in. He's in K'aresh now, and he's allowed me to open the way for you if you require transportation.
94933.title: Lessons in the Void

94936.description:
My brother Tekkan and I were part of a team. Our friend Kariz died fighting de snakes.

Kariz's younger brother, Jabat, was consumed by vengeance. He is young and hot-headed, blind to his actions. He took off to kill de snakes. He is in great danger.

The Right Spear doesn't want to send a rescue, and I won't let their mother cry twice. We are going to get Jabat.

We need to plan an escape route for when we find Jabat. Tekkan can handle snake burrows with his explosives, but we need a muscle. You in?
94936.title: A Bond of Brothers

94937.description:
I only have one small explosive left. Even if Aol'ggin is right about my methods, we can't go back now. I...

<Tekkan chokes on his words, then clears his throat.>

We can do dis. You lure de snakes out and deal with dem so I can safely blow up de burrow. De escape route will be cleared after dat.
94937.title: Too Quiet on the Northern Front

94941.description:
That large snake was the one who killed Kariz. And now I see Jabat is wounded and in danger. Tekkan is not responsive. I don't know what is wrong with him. There is no time to waste and I don't want to ask what else can go wrong. Dis is bad luck.

Check on Jabat or take out de large snake right away. Whatever you decide to do first, dat large snake must die.
94941.title: Saving Recruit Jabat

94954.description:
Today, celebrate da Darkspear footrunners. 

Long ago, our footrunners ran 'round all da troll empire deliverin' important messages. Dey carried their messages through battle an' storm an' were famous for dey courage. 

Today we be celebratin' not dey courage in war, but da courage of some of da messages dey carried--messages of peace an' hope for a better world.

Help us send a message of hope by joinin' our symbolic run ta Silvermoon. 

Ya be ready? Well go, mon!
94954.title: Darkspear Dash

94957.description:
The Vanguard has begun to rally its forces to confront the Devouring Host.

Report to Lady Liadrin at the Sunwell to join the offensive.
94957.title: War of Light and Shadow

94993.description: The Void encroaches on Azeroth from all sides. Visit the Scouting Map in the Sanctum of Light and choose where you will make your stand.
94993.title: Adventuring in Midnight

95008.description:
It's rare that we get to choose our paths in life, but you seem like someone who's seen it all before.

<Soridormi winks.>

Don't dally, this war won't win itself. Go to the Sanctum of Light. Choose where you'll make your first stand.
95008.title: Adventuring in Midnight

95009.description:
Have you heard about the race today?

Thousands of trolls are gathering to run to Silvermoon City for a celebration!

Kalaya could tell you more. They're setting up at the Echo Isles now!
95009.title: Doing the Dash

95012.description:
Have you heard about the race today?

Thousands of gnomes are preparing to run from New Tinkertown to Booty Bay in celebration!

Mina Gleespanner could tell you more. They're just about to start!
95012.title: Run On Gnome

95021.description:
This creature has established a reputation for particularly vicious ambushes. Envenomed fangs flashing in the dark, followed by frenzied thrashing and then... stillness. 

See if you cannot give it a taste of its own venom.
95021.title: Prey: Janoa the Fang (Nightmare)

95022.description:
Do not let this serpentine monstrosity get close, {name}, lest you have the life squeezed out of you. My servants recently found one of its unfortunate victims.

Like a fistful of mashed grapes...

Apologies, I lost myself for a moment there.
95022.title: Prey: Kursak the Coiled (Nightmare)

95023.description:
I have heard that this creature has scales so thick and sharp you could use them to filet a fish. Do not let its diminutive stature fool you, {name}, it was bred for one purpose. 

To kill. 

Fortunately, not being killed is something you've grown quite proficient in.
95023.title: Prey: Batani the Scaled (Nightmare)

95024.description: The claw! A miracle of the natural world. An appendage located at the cutting edge of murderous millennia. This creature is all claw and cunning, and you would do best to not fall prey to its violent nature.
95024.title: Prey: Kadani the Claw (Nightmare)

95069.description:
<The Twilight Missive reads:

"Our search presses on yet we remain as divided as ever. If we don't unite, then we truly deserved to be abandoned by her!

Of our surviving Speakers, two refuse my missives.

Lazaar rallies survivors in the ruins of Deatholme, while Ger'lock amasses a host at the Broken Throne.

The others have yet to declare for them, which buys us time to continue our search.

We may yet salvage our broken cause."

The Ranger Captain will want to see this.>
95069.title: Torn Twilight Missive

95070.description:
<Several void-touched runes flicker across the keystone's surface before dissipating one by one. As the last rune fades, so does the faint hum of power within, leaving nothing but a painfully cold sphere of dark green metal.> 

Although it doesn't resemble other domanaar artifacts, there was no mistaking the cold, dark magic.

Perhaps Decimus in the Howling Ridge can provide you with more information.>
95070.title: Permafrosted Keystone

95071.description:
<The enchanted scroll shimmers with an arcane glint, the text vaguely resembling the elven language.

You presume it is written in the language of the naga, though the arcane-laced ink appears to move the letters around the scroll.

Perhaps a mage in Silvermoon can help you translate it.>
95071.title: Enchanted Naga Scroll

95114.description:
Ah, {name}. I have been looking for you. My... contacts have told me much regarding your continued attempts to defend our beloved city.

But there is another way.

Come, join me in Murder Row and we can get to work.
95114.title: Prey: A Crimson Summons

95175.description:
We need your help to activate the Singularity Anchor. 

With proper defenses we can counter enemy assaults long enough to activate the device. If the Anchor is destroyed our efforts will be halted.

Do what you can to help us.
95175.title: Anchoring the Defense

95215.description:
<Your hand burns with felfire as a scroll materializes within your grasp. The seal bears the mark of the Illidari.>

{name}, as leader of the Illidari in Lord Illidan's absence, you must choose your second-in-command.

Kayn or Altruis. You can only choose one.

The chosen shall become your personal champion, and their ideology will color our decisions for the Illidari going forward. No matter who is chosen, our mission remains unchanged.

-Kor'vas Bloodthorn
95215.title: A New Direction

95245.description:
The immediate danger has passed, but there is still much to be done.

Go out and work with our allies to secure what ground we have made against the darkness. Whether it is in Azeroth or beyond, there is still much to be done.
95245.title: Midnight: World Tour

95268.description:
There is another sort of Void power I know you will be interested in. An Ascendant Voidcore is difficult to come by, and even more difficult to work. With the Voidforge completed, I can now weave a magnificent Nilhammer capable of such things. Of course, I will need you to help with the materials. It will take time.

Take this chunk of Hungering Oblivium. It can devour moments of extreme violence to be catalyzed to new heights of power, but I don't think you'll have any trouble managing that, will you?
95268.title: New Tools, New Heights

95271.description: At last, we've collected enough power to fully weave the Nilhammer!
95271.title: The Ascendant Nilhammer

95276.description:
Our forces are starting to move out to take the fight to Xal'atath. 

I've received word there are many areas that you've visited that could still use some aid. 

We must focus our attention on the counter offensive. Can you help those that are in need?
95276.title: The Last Push

95324.description:
Your actions in Harandar caused quite an uproar. The elders are up in arms. The rootwardens are worried. It's really quite exhausting.

But there is good news as well. Orweyna has heard rumblings from every corner of the roots. She tells me of haranir who wish to see the world as she does--who feel compelled to seek the goddess beyond the boughs of Harandar.

I will handle things in Harandar. Go to your leaders. Tell them that the haranir are ready to join the fight.
95324.title: The War Beyond the Roots

95336.description:
Ya be down for helping me out with a little spot of bother?

Shajanji be over in the mountains collecting some local rocks. If you could go help her out, I'd be mighty grateful ta ya. Just bring them back ta me. I be keeping them safe for her.

I--She needs a lot of them. She be an avid collector.
95336.title: Frenzied Fossicking

95355.description:
<This Lurker was carrying some items it looted from a fallen soldier.

...These items feel familiar.

The letter is addressed to Namaji in Amani'Zar Village. Perhaps these items should be returned to her.>
95355.title: The Messenger

95373.description:
I see you haven't come across a Nebulous Voidcore before. I can now weave them for you from the energies of the Catalyst as they accumulate, but you'll have to provide raw reagents.

With the Voidcore in hand, you'll have to seek out powerful enemies in order to transmute it into useful equipment. Its capable of capturing part of their essence to become something more powerful that you can put to use in the battles ahead.
95373.title: A Nebulous Endeavour

95406.description:
Oh thank goodness you are here!

Some of my precious orange kitties were so eager to play in the neighborhood they've all run off to explore. Please help me find them!
95406.title: Lost Animals

95407.description: Race through the checkpoint rings marking the course.
95407.title: Autumnal Addresses

95408.description: Race through the checkpoint rings marking the course.
95408.title: Coastal Courier

95409.description: Race through the checkpoint rings marking the course.
95409.title: High Road, Hollow Road

95410.description: Race through the checkpoint rings marking the course.
95410.title: Cragthorn Certified

95411.description: Race through the checkpoint rings marking the course.
95411.title: Desert Dispatch

95412.description: Race through the checkpoint rings marking the course.
95412.title: Runetotem Run

95413.description:
Ah hello, {name}. I have a flier for you.

<Vaeli hands you a glossy piece of paper.>

DON'T MISS OUT!!!

Don't miss this amazing deal available only to you! Present this coupon on your next purchase from your neighborhood endeavor trader, and get bonus items for free!

Coupon valid for one week. Terms and conditions apply.
95413.title: Community Engagement

95416.description:
With so many new residents, mail in the neighborhoods is really starting to pile up. So many routes and just one of me! If only I could deputize an assistant mail carrier...

Say, {name}, would you be willing to help out? I've got some juicy parcels from the dead letter office I could offer in thanks.
95416.title: Going Postal

95438.description:
{name}, I am so glad to see you.

A good friend of mine has sent a letter informing me she lost track of some of her tiny pets throughout the neighborhood! She's asking for assistance from anyone who can help!

Help find her lost animals right away!
95438.title: Lost Animals

95439.description:
{name}, I am so glad to see you.

A good friend of mine has sent a letter informing me of an issue she is having within the neighborhood, specifically having to do with her large collection of pets!

She seemed very stressed and worried, I would not delay on seeking her out to help!
95439.title: Lost Animals

95440.description:
Kirin Tor scholars have argued for centuries over the semantics of a "gathering".

How many people are required? For how long must they remain? Who is bringing the beverages?

Debates have raged into the night. Papers written. Research grants awarded.

Consensus yet eludes the scholars, but they still meet often to deliberate. They take turns bringing beverages.
95440.title: Housewarming

95468.description:
I can't imagine what will happen to Quel'Thalas if the Sunwell falls to the forces of the Void.

We need you out on the battlefield, {name}. Bring hope and heroism to the people across these lands.
95468.title: Hope in the Darkest Corners

95482.description:
{name}, I am so glad to see you.

A good friend of mine has sent a letter informing me of an issue she is having within the neighborhood, specifically having to do with her large collection of pets!

She seemed very stressed and worried, I would not delay on seeking her out to help!
95482.title: Lost Animals

95520.description:
De fiends of dis temple would see us all dead. We are all dat stands between them and de mainland, you understand? We hold dem here.

Not one scale, not one bony finger, none of them will leave dis temple while we breathe.

Get out there and cut them down.
95520.title: Purging the Vaults

95521.description: <The ancient gem pulses faintly. Scratches adorn its sides as if pried away with desperate eagerness. Perhaps the troll spirit, Me'si, will know where this came from.>
95521.title: The Med'jai Medallion

95522.description:
In de legends passed down, dey speak of a group of heroic guardians whose sacrifice protect us to dis day. These honored few, known as de Med'jai, adorned their belts with gems like these--de better to draw their enemies in and defeat dem.

We were told dey went on a great expedition to fight de evil abroad, but it seems de greatest of de evils was within--below our feet.

Please, {name}, search for dis gem's true home. If our ancestor spirits watch over us, perhaps we will find their resting place.
95522.title: Guardians of Death, Guardians in Stone

95523.description:
De Soulcoilers must pay, {name}.

De Soulcoilers believed their actions saved de Amani. Instead, our people and our future was plundered. We did not realize until it was too late.

End them. Shatter their very souls so that even de great Mueh'zala cannot put dem back together.
95523.title: Worthy of the Past

95524.description:
I am not de only Med'jai tasked with keeping sentinel over de priests. There were three of us, entombed in stone that matched how we looked in life.

I must know if dey are still there. Can you help me find them? My body is bound in dis stone, but my spirit is not. Bring my gem to those places, if you can find dem.

If we cannot wake dem, we will at least honor dem.
95524.title: The Unremembered

95525.description:
De temple has changed since I began my watch, {name}. When you first woke me, all I saw was corruption and impure spirits. De consequence of our weakness.

Now, I see dat we have not failed. De battlefield has changed, as dey always do.

Please take my gem and bring it back to de others like you. Perhaps my spirit can become a force for good on dis new battlefield, in a new way.
95525.title: A Worthy Vigil

95547.description: <The information in the scrolls speaks of a mysterious vine attracted to the high levels of magic at Ritual Sites. This is the type of information Lady Darkglen needs to be told to better prepare for countering future Ritual Sites.>
95547.title: Ritual Site Challenge Report: Tendrils

95548.description:
<This sample is tainted and reeks of unknown scents.

Perhaps Lady Darkglen would be interested in studying it further.>
95548.title: Tainted Sample

95549.description:
I have a request.

These Ritual Sites invoke some interesting magic. I would like you to obtain some sample readings.

You don't need to concern yourself with the details. Just visit the area I will mark on your map and press the button.

You may end up garnering some extra attention when you do so.
95549.title: Raising Magical Alarms

95550.description:
I don't like it.

We have far too many scouts returning wounded from these so-called ritual sites.

Thin out the ranks of these cultists.
95550.title: Thin Their Ranks

95551.description:
<It seems the cultists have added theft to their repertoire.

You should reclaim the stolen treasures from the Ritual Site and return them to Rae'ana.>
95551.title: Misappropriated Treasures

95552.description:
{race}, we have reports that the leaders of the Ritual Sites are using dark obelisks to bolster their forces with malevolent boons.

I need you to investigate the objects they are using to gain these boons.
95552.title: Dark Obelisk Investigation

95553.description:
I'm hearing strange murmurings from my scouts.

Some are claiming that strange manifestations are appearing and cursing intruders.

Could I ask you to investigate and see if there is any truth to these rumors?
95553.title: Manifested Density

95554.description:
<This creature was being enhanced by an unknown magic.

Perhaps you should gather more of these fragments.>
95554.title: Questionable Power

95564.description:
De Shadowpine shamans are at our hash'ey's command. We speak de language of fire from de wing of Jan'alai, but we also need help.

With de help of the other tribes, we have secured this camp. But we won't hold it for long without your help.

I have a few things I would ask you to do, hash'ura, if you are willin'.
95564.title: The Serpent's Tail

95673.description:
Hey there, could ya help a poor troll down on their luck?

I'm looking for some feathers from ya neighborhood.

If ya give the birds around here a good scare, they'll take off and drop some, just bring them back here.
95673.title: Suspicious Scare-gull

95768.description:
Hey there, {name}.

I set up shop to trade some of our neighborhood goods with our new friends here, and I've been selling like hotcakes!

I could use a break though, would you mind watching the shop for me? If any customers come by, just offer them what you think is best.
95768.title: My Stuff's Better Than Your Stuff

95779.description:
A man who knows his way around a drink deserves the finest brew. I have just the thing in mind for my friend, Flynn.

The ingredients I need are within my family's brewery in the Valley of Four Winds. I would fetch them myself, but a brewmaster must also know when to sit, breathe, and appreciate what is within the mug.

Would you go to Stormstout Brewery and bring those ingredients to me, friend?
95779.title: Moments in a Mug

95780.description:
Garona and I both don't talk about our childhoods much. There's not a lot worth saying.

The children in that orphanage in Shattrath--they're living what we lived. I'm not asking you to fix that. I'm asking you to show up and remind them the world holds something worth fighting for.

For me, revenge was worth fighting for. But maybe they can have a brighter future.

Go play games with them. Try to show them what a person worth looking up to actually is.
95780.title: Hope for the Orphans

95781.description:
Skitter like Myritt. Myritt is sad, wants gift for his friend. 

Candle is best gift. Help find the best candle for Myritt.
95781.title: No Wax Like Home

95804.description:
Are these tortollans lost? How long have dey been here?

We have a settlement of dem near de Shrine of Filo, but dis is a place dey should not be.

A day not long ago, I would have chased dem off. But we've been havin' good luck with outsiders.

<A hint of a smile crosses Zul'jarra's face. It's the first you've seen since before Malacrass's return.>

We should talk to dem. Maybe dey know how dis started.
95804.title: The Children of Ula'tek

95842.description:
Both Void forces and old enemies press us in this turbulent time. We must stay vigilant and let no faction gain a foothold.

You must put a stop to these Void assaults! Stay alert, our scouts report some factions may be using the smaller strikes to prepare for a major incursion. 

If so, I know you will help with the defense.
95842.title: Midnight: Void Assaults

95843.description:
There have been many enemies that seek to use dark rituals to send horrors our way. The rangers have always risen to challenge and dealt with them. 

With the pressure on our forces, I must ask you to take up this mission. There are dangerous Ritual Sites that must be disrupted. 

Our enemies will most likely try again, so you must be dogged and continue to thwart them each time they make the attempt.
95843.title: Midnight: Ritual Sites

95933.description:
Champion, Riftblade Maella would like to speak with you again.

The dark particles you have brought us, the information you've been gathering on our enemies and the countless victories you have bought for Quel'Thalas have not gone unnoticed.

It seems Maella has a plan. Seek her out when you can.
95933.title: Traces in the Dark

95954.description:
You have done well, {name}, but a shadow remains cast over the temple, in the form of the High Priest Jin'tal.

A particularly fervent and ambitious priest in life, I am unsurprised that he has survived into undeath. I sense that he practices his abhorrent faith in the nearby Mortuary.

Please, {name}. End him. I will help you if I can.
95954.title: An Ancient Foe

95973.description:
Magister Umbric has been keeping an eye on the Twilight's Blade, receiving reports from the field. 

He thinks something is afoot. 

That is not all. He said that he has also been keeping an eye on Arator since the Darkwell, and has developed... concerns about him.

Go, speak with him.
95973.title: Echoes of the Darkwell

96004.description:
Do you feel it, {name}?

We are being watched. 

I do not know by whom, or to what end, but it appears that our... efforts have drawn fresh attention. Go out and survey the field.

Let us test the mettle of these newcomers.
96004.title: Prey: A Slithering Threat

96048.description:
<A void-touched missive materializes before you.>

{name},

Your efforts against the recent void and ethereal incursions have paid off. It's time we take the fight to them.

Meet me at the Ranger-Captain's strike station in Silvermoon.

Do not delay.

Riftblade Maella
96048.title: The Time to Strike

96049.description:
With the help of Belath Dawnblade and Decimus, we've learned our enemies orchestrate their attacks from former Legion worlds.

I've requested the demon hunter's aid in navigating these worlds and fortifying our defenses.

Seek them out and lend them any assistance they need. Inform Belath we mobilize soon.
96049.title: Stalkers of the Stars

96051.description:
The Legion keystone and the dark particles you found gave us a needle in the endless, vast haystack of the Twisting Nether.

With the Cynosure of Twilight, the artifact used to open the way to the Voidstorm, we can thread this needle and open a rift to our enemy's doorstep.

With the components in place, my riftwardens stand at the ready.

Take up the Cynosure and point and be ready, {name}.
96051.title: Through the Cold Rift

96052.description:
The energy from the Hal'hadar battery core and dark particles allowed us to piece together a faint trail of nether energy.

With the Cynosure of Twilight, we can illuminate and ignite this trail, taking us directly to our enemy's doorstep.

The anchors are in place and my riftwalkers await your move.

Take up the Cynosure and point. Let us see what awaits us on the other side.
96052.title: Through the Mana Rift

96053.description:
We still hold the element of surprise, which gives us a moment to fortify our position.

While Y'mera opens a more stable travel network for the rest of our forces, our scouts have gone ahead to survey the terrain.

Meet with them in the field and activate our surveillance beacons.

I will remain here to cover the arrival of our reinforcements.
96053.title: Surveying the Frozen Wastes

96054.description:
Our sudden arrival allows us a brief moment to fortify our hold here.

While Y'mera works on bringing the rest of our forces through a more stable network, our scouts have gone ahead to survey the terrain and the enemy.

Meet with them in the field and activate our surveillance beacons.

I will remain here with Y'mera and Decimus should any of those skiffs overhead decide to pay us a visit.
96054.title: Surveying the Mana-Bog

96070.title: 12.1-  Housing - Founders - Local Local Story 01 - Q01 - Escort - (POC)

96071.description:
Ah, {name}, yer here.

My husbands been lying to me about where he's been going after work. I'm worried he's in some kind o' trouble.

I hate to ask, but can ye follow him? I can't follow him meself, he'd notice me.
96071.title: 12.1-  Housing - Founders - Local Local Story 01 - Q02 - Escort - (POC)

96072.description:
<You've followed Thromnil to a secret rendevous with another woman.

Time to report back to Greta, unless you want to overhear what they are saying.>
96072.title: 12.1-  Housing - Founders - Local Local Story 01 - Q03 - Escort - (POC)

96073.title: 12.1-  Housing - Founders - Local Local Story 01 - Q04 - Escort - (POC)

96074.title: 12.1-  Housing - Founders - Local Local Story 01 - Q05 - Escort - (POC)

96080.description:
We have reports of new void strikes occurring around Eversong Forest and Zul'Aman. 

We need you to head out immediately to investigate one of these strikes. I will mark your map with the latest location from our scouts.
96080.title: Void Strike

96089.description:
Whatever's wrong with her, whatever those creatures did, I need her healed!

Will you help?
96089.title: Somethin's Not Right

96090.description:
I have the other ingredients for the emetic here. The last ingredient I need is some venom to trigger a response.

I overheard the trolls talk about a place just to the north called the Serpent's Tail. They say it's chock-full of venomous baddies, but we only need the poison from the Children of Ula'tek.

They say there are even rivers full of the caustic stuff, but don't go swimming in them. They're too concentrated and will eat right through the collection bottle before you can scream, "I'm melting!"
96090.title: Venemetic

96091.description:
I've set up three bottles with different ingredients. All you have to do is add just the right amount... just a dash of venom to each. Balance them out.

You can use Ofi's cauldron right over there. I'm sure she won't mind. Whatever's in there has likely been bubbling since before she was born.

No, I'm not going to do it for you. I've lived long enough to know not to touch that stuff!

Once you have the results, give the emetic to your medic friend and we'll see what happens.
96091.title: Get the Balance Right

96092.description:
Unfortunately, this has moved beyond my area of expertise.

Fortunately, I know someone who can help. Probably.

Unfortunately, he left for some "great adventure" on Gnarldor Isle to the south. More likely, he's on a great bender.

Here, take this elixir and give it to our former ship's doctor, Ruma. I always like to keep one handy. It'll sober him right up.

Then it's on you to convince him to devise a cure. Good luck!
96092.title: That Fool, Ruma

96093.description:
Well, you see, I was on quite the adventure with my friend, Tormunda, and a few others. Seeing the world, sipping exotic drinks, rest and relaxation. But then, disaster struck our camp.

Gnarldin!

We were separated and I did what you're supposed to do when you're lost: stay where you are. So, I've been resting here.

But I'm afraid in all the commotion, I left my satchel behind. It has all of my best things in it.

So you see, if you want my help, you'll have to go and get it for me.
96093.title: It's a Satchel, Not a Bag

96094.description:
If we're to help this La'una of yours, we need to go to the source. You said they were scouting the western ledge of the Fangs when all of this happened?

Everyone knows you don't go there. We should NOT go out there. But, that is precisely where we must go because that's where we'll find the cure.

Or, meet our demise. Whichever comes first.

<Ruma begins rummaging through his pack for a refreshment.>
96094.title: To the Forum

96095.description:
If I'm going to devise a cure, I need samples and plenty of them.

Lucky for us we have the two things we need: You and all of the infected wildlife roaming throughout this place.
96095.title: Sampling the Local Wildlife

96096.description:
When we first came out here our leader, Dusk Prowler Hano'mon, took de team too far in. He always was a... not very well-liked.

I was scoutin' de rear and by de time I came across La'una, she was already affected by whatever dis is.

It's possible de rest of my scout team is still out there. If dey are, I need to know their fate, one way or de other.

Their names are A'pone, Kamaina, Ko'ruku, Uha'ne, and Hano'mon.
96096.title: Scout Team Seven

96097.description:
If my guess is correct, I think I know what we're missing.

Would you be so kind as to ask these scouts about what they've seen while they were out there? I suspect they already know what, or who, is behind all of this.
96097.title: What the Scouts Saw

96098.description:
I saw de Children of Ula'tek as well, {name}. Dey both are conjurin' in their separate towers out there.

Now it's time to put an end to de threat. We can't have dem comin' out of de Vaults of Atal'Utek and spreadin' dis infection all over Zul'Aman... or farther.

And don't forget about de reagents de doctor needs!
96098.title: The Final Reagents

96099.description:
The prescription is ready. Now all we have to do, all YOU have to do, is give it to the patient.

Don't worry, it'll work. I'm sure of it. Well, I'm mostly sure. Let's say, sixty-seven percent certain. Those are pretty good odds considering the alternative.
96099.title: La'una's Fate

96110.description:
If ye mean to be part of my crew, ye best be ready to handle the venom curse.

Know how to fish? Every creature with gills on this isle is ready to sink its teeth into you.

Prove ye can fish up even the smallest of the venom-cursed fish and I'll show ye how to take on deadlier and nastier fishin'.
96110.title: Venom Fishing: Proof is in the Ooze

96111.description:
You've learned some o' my secrets to fishin' in these cursed waters, but everything ye learn from here on serves a greater purpose than survival.

Revenge.

The Great White Serpent that sank my ship is still alive. If we intend to kill it, we need the power o' my crew, now lost to the venom-curse.

Master Grenadier Birdie has one good shot: her first shot. Build yerself a decoy and you'll have a chance to kill her.

Take her explosives. We'll need 'em to blow that snake to smithereens.
96111.title: Venom Fishing: Shell of Yourself

96112.description:
We need somethin' to protect that shell-less back o' yers when we face the Great White Serpent.

Leathertongue made dishes that made us immune to nigh anything, this being on account o' them nearly killin' us every mealtime!

His pots and pans could withstand any nightmare. We need that strength.

The key to defeating the cook is to challenge his skill. Make a dish of the foulest ingredients and he'll be there to face ye.
96112.title: Venom Fishing: Maddening Concoction

96113.description:
We're almost ready to face the Great White Serpent. We only need one more thing.

I want ye to take my quartermaster's boat.

Inktail has plans on plans. Before the venom, she was cool and reserved even in the wildest storms. With the venom curse, she's become even more elusive.

I've only seen her lose her deadly composure once. She has a mighty love of rare fish.

It's a gamble, but go into the temple and find a fish overwhelmed with venom. It may be enough to draw her out of hidin'.
96113.title: Venom Fishing: Maximum Potency

96223.description:
<A floating missive hangs before you, written in a flowing magical script. At first, it appears to be nonsense.

As you approach the parchment, the words shift and change, and a message forms.>

The Magisters request your presence at Thalassian University. Please proceed to the upper levels overlooking the harbor.

This concerns a private matter of minor urgency.
96223.title: The Magisters' Call

96224.description:
Magisters' Terrace is home to many mysterious artifacts.

Among them is a relic once central to our pursuit of magical knowledge. A few years ago, the relic fell into a state of dormancy.

After the Dawnwell reignited, this artifact began to stir. Upon returning it to the Lycaneum for study, the relic unleashed chaos upon the library.

I believe your unique expertise may be helpful in quelling this chaos.
96224.title: The Magisters' Conundrum

96225.description:
For the last few decades, a dormant artifact laid beneath the halls of Magisters' Terrace.

Once serving as a beacon of knowledge to the Magisters, the artifact abruptly fell silent some decades ago.

After the Dawnwell's rebirth, the artifact reawakened. When we returned it to the Lycaneum for study, it unleashed chaos upon the library.

Your assistance, and discretion, would be most appreciated.
96225.title: The Magisters' Conundrum

96226.description:
Shortly after the Omnium awoke, it began manifesting arcane anomalies around the Lycaneum.

We believe these anomalies to be malfunctioning security protocols--the hostile projections they conjure can be quite lethal.

If we do not dispatch them quickly, they will continue to manifest.

As you deal with them, keep an eye out for anything peculiar that can help us understand the Omnium's current state.
96226.title: Omnium Anomalies

96227.description:
When the Omnium began to stir in its vault, we thought to move it here for observation. Evidently, this was a bad idea.

The arcane magics seeping out are causing chaos.

Folios casting all sorts of incomplete spells, arcane sparks running amok--even the candle flames have sprung to life!

But we cannot simply destroy them, as the magics here are too volatile. I have procured a ward-lance from the arsenal of the spellbreakers. It will dispel the volatile magic.

Here, take it. And do be careful.
96227.title: Lycaneum Chaos

96228.description:
Time and time again, Dar'Khan continues to haunt us in some form.

To think the Omnium also fell prey to his madness...

If he really severed the Void Magicule from the Omnium, then I have no doubt he would have hidden it well.

I have a suspicion I know where to start looking.

Meet me at Dawnstar Spire in Eversong Woods.
96228.title: The Shadowed Spire

96229.description:
After reclaiming Silvermoon, the Magisters torched Dar'Khan's personal study and dwellings within the city walls.

I had thought I had found everything I needed the first time I searched this place, but now...

It seems that Dar'Khan left some secrets.

This portal will take us to them. I do not know what we will find on the other side. Be on your guard.
96229.title: The Void Reveals

96230.description:
The Magicules, the orbs you see on the relic, were never meant to be severed from the Omnium. By tearing one out, Dar'Khan likely sent the artifact into a frenzied state before it shut down. 

Even if the Void Magicule is restored, the Omnium will need recalibrating. We will need Belo'vir's key-cipher, now my key-cipher, to do this.

I will meet you at my study and we can recover it.
96230.title: Unraveling the Wards

96231.description:
After Belo'vir's death, I contemplated opening this vault. I talked myself out of it.

A key for a shattered lock serves no purpose.

And yet, even as Kael'thas tried to open it with his key, I couldn't help but wonder...

It doesn't matter, {name}. I am nearly done with the master ward on the upper floor. Meet me there.

No doubt, Belo'vir took extra steps to safeguard his vault.
96231.title: The Grand Magister's Key-Cipher

96232.description:
Well, now that we've recovered the piece Dar'Khan stole, we are one step closer to restoring the Omnium.

Hopefully your endeavor with Rommath was a little less troublesome?

When you're ready, return to the Magisters' Terrace. I will clean up anything left behind here and join you shortly.
96232.title: Return to the Omnium

96233.description:
For years, as Silvermoon and its people changed, this relic sat in a vault beneath the Terrace, unresponsive and dormant.

We may never truly understand why the relic fell silent when it did or why it refused the prince's call, but perhaps in time, we might.

Let us hope the missing Magicule and the key-cipher will be enough to restore it.

Are you ready, {name}?
96233.title: The Omnium Reawakens

96238.description:
With Belo'vir's key-cipher recovered and Umbric in possession of the Void Magicule, we should return to the Lycaneum.

Hopefully we have all that we need to recalibrate the Sunstrider Omnium.

I will meet you back in the Magisters' Terrace when I am done here.
96238.title: Return to the Omnium

96242.description:
You can always speak to me to enter a game of Decor Duel, but did you know there's an easier way?

If there's a group you want to find, we have "magic" to help!
96242.title: An Easy Path to Trickery

96245.description: <A fine parchment materializes in a shower of bronze dust. It is an invitation from Soridormi to visit her at the Wayfarer's Rest in Silvermoon City.>
96245.title: You've Seen it All Before

96267.description:
When de Children of Ula'tek seized dis temple, many of my ancestors died defendin' it. Sacred relics were seized by de snakes! Even now, dey twist those items into foul magic!

Among these items were some gems of great power.

Search de vaults, ritual chambers, and every deep corner of de temple and recover any gems you find.
96267.title: Ancestral Gems

96271.description:
When de poison spread through dis temple, many of our ancestors fell trying to defend dis place.

Now Nek'zali has ensnared their spirits to serve her in restoring Ula'tek. Put de cursed spirits to rest so dey may pass beyond dis place.
96271.title: Cursed Existence

96273.description:
De Children of Ula'tek have upset de balance of de spirit world. Many spirits are angry and demand justice before dey can move on.

De snakes' blood will restore de balance!

Slay de Children of Ula'tek and all dat aid dem here in de temple.
96273.title: A Balance Paid in Blood

96275.description:
Too many spirits here have succumbed to de dark charms of Nek'zali, but there's still hope to save others.

Place spirit guardians throughout de lakes of venom so dey may offer sanctuary to spirits nearby. 

De venom lakes are deadly, so go prepared!
96275.title: Wading In

96276.description:
De Children of Ula'tek play cruel games on de spirits here. Dey use dark charms to keep dem trapped and tormented.

De charms are hidden throughout de temple. Find and burn them, so de spirits here can find peace.
96276.title: Dark Charms

96305.description:
When de defenders fell, cursed to their fate, so too did de great eagle Tok'jara who flew with dem. Such innocence did not deserve dis curse.

Even now, de spirit struggles to break free, forming a twisting geyser as it rises from the venomous pools.

Help it be free, claim its essence from the poison, and end its suffering.
96305.title: The Innocent Essence

96310.description:
Great work defeating their forces. Every step we take will keep Azeroth safe.

But usurpers are still trying to seize control. Baraat has already spotted high ranking domanaar looking at the remaining resources.

We need to defeat the Umbrawardens and any of their forces along the way.
96310.title: Disrupting the Order

96338.description:
{name}, take a look at that platform above. What do you think they use that for?

The void creatures steal wildlife from Azeroth and move them here to be broken, then added to their forces. That platform must be where creatures are first brought in.

Let's force our way through any defenses up there and destroy that portal!
96338.title: Port of Entry

96349.description:
When de Children of Ula'tek seized dis temple, many of my ancestors died defendin' it. Sacred relics were seized by de snakes! Even now, dey twist those items into foul magic!

Among these items were some gems of great power.

Search de vaults, ritual chambers, and every deep corner of de temple and recover any gems you find.
96349.title: Ancestral Gems

96352.description:
De Children of Ula'tek play cruel games on de spirits here. Dey use dark charms to keep dem trapped and tormented.

De charms be hidden throughout de temple. Find and burn them, so de spirits here can find peace.
96352.title: Dark Charms

96354.description:
De Children of Ula'tek have upset de balance of de spirit world. Many spirits be angry and demand justice before dey can move on.

De snakes' blood will restore de balance!

Slay de Children of Ula'tek and all dat aid dem here in de temple.
96354.title: A Balance Paid in Blood

96360.description:
Too many spirits here have succumbed to de dark charms of Nek'zali, but there's still hope to save others.

Place spirit guardians throughout de lakes of venom so dey may offer sanctuary to spirits nearby. 

De venom lakes are deadly, so go prepared!
96360.title: Wading In

96361.description:
When de poison spread through dis temple, many of our ancestors fell trying to defend dis place.

Now Nek'zali has ensnared their spirits to serve her in restoring Ula'tek. Put de cursed spirits to rest so dey may pass beyond dis place.
96361.title: Cursed Existence

96382.description:
For this threat, you'll need to think more like the domanaar. Luckily, I can do just that.

What we need is a puppet. Someone we can give the reins who has no aspirations for your precious Azeroth. Those new domanaar you saw will need evaluation.

Take this veil. You'll be able to blend in and observe them. I understand your urge to strike, but be patient. The time will come to eliminate all in your path, as your kind seems to enjoy.

See if you can find a proper candidate.
96382.title: A New Approach

96388.description:
Ya ever heard of de Abyss Anglers?

Forest tribes have been hunting de land as well as de waters for generations.

Don't be shy, hash'ura. Grab a suit and go for a dive!
96388.title: Joining the Abyss Anglers

96389.description:
While you were attuning the gem to the Void, I managed to acquire one of Impotus's projection devices. 

We're going to use it to lure him to us, then prevent him from escaping with the gem. 

Not here, though. Let us find somewhere more discrete.
96389.title: A Place to Negotiate

96410.description:
Those who sought to learn from the Omnium had to contribute to it.

While most Magisters studied within the Terrace, a select few were appointed as "Seekers of Wisdom."

Seekers would search for new and foreign magic to contribute to the Omnium's vast index for study.

Given your... adventurous experience, I think you'd make an excellent seeker.

If you're interested, the Grand Magister will explain more.
96410.title: Seeking Knowledge Week 1 of 5: The Omnium Folio

96439.description:
These infernal nests are where de Children of Ula'tek spawn from. We must work to clear dem out if we are to have any hope of stemming de endless tide of snakes.

I have been sending groups of my most fearless scouts to gather information on dem. All have returned... except for one.

Go, track down Ulantu and Naj'kula in de Blistering Terrace. Find out why dey gone dark.
96439.title: Gone Dark

96440.description:
Great work, {name}! I can already picture the walls of the Acropolis crumbling.

In fact, why don't we head there now and press our advantage? The Light can shine through the tiniest of cracks.

I'll scout ahead and meet you on the way there.
96440.title: Victory Within Hindsight

96441.description:
The nature of the Dawnwell has sparked a question among the minds of Magisters' Terrace:

If magic can corrupt and suffuse other magics, how will the Dawnwell affect the ley lines branching out from it?

With inquiry, comes experiment.

The Ritual Sites in Quel'Thalas use the ley lines to fuel their magic.

Disrupt these sites and retrieve samples of the arcana you find.
96441.title: Seeking Knowledge Week 2 of 5: Ritualized Arcana

96442.description:
Unfortunately, most of the measurable samples were expunged by the Ritual Site's excessive energy.

If we are to accurately measure the various magics seeping into the ley lines, we'll need samples from a broader, less concentrated source.

I am told the Farstriders continue to route the void strikes across Quel'Thalas.

Bring me coalesced ley energy from any of the assaulting forces.
96442.title: Seeking Knowledge Week 3 of 5: Ley Line Assaults

96443.description:
Thanks to your efforts, we've isolated the effects of trace amounts of foreign magic coalescing with the ley lines.

Our next phase is to compare these results against a pure sample of magic coalescing with the same energy.

Your task is to track down a primessence of magic--be it arcane, Void, Light, or other--and acquire it from its deadly source.

Good luck, {name}.
96443.title: Seeking Knowledge Week 4 of 5: Magical Primessence

96444.description:
Although it made an excellent catalyst, the primessence you retrieved revealed a factor we did not account for.

The alien nature of the Void and ethereal magic used in their assaults proved incompatible with the experiment.

We need a sample of their magic if we are to make any progress--not from the assaults here in Quel'Thalas, but from the source of their attacks.

I am told these enemies strike from off-world staging grounds. Good luck, {name}.
96444.title: Seeking Knowledge Week 5 of 5: Off-World Magic

96446.description:
A vision of tides permeates your mind.

Eldara Dawnrunner might have more information regarding these Sparks of Tides.
96446.title: Spark of Tides

96450.description:
Naj'kula and I were here to observe how the Children of Ula'tek reproduce.

We discovered dis lich, Lokago. Malacrass had him experimentin' on kidnapped Amani. I stole his records to try and figure out why, but de lich discovered us. I was injured. I dropped everythin'.

Naj'kula was right behind me... We gotta recover de notes--and find Naj'kula!
96450.title: Sideways

96451.description:
I don't like dis. We should have found her by now.

<Ulantu's face is sweaty and pale. She rubs her wound absentmindedly.>

De lich must have dragged her back to where he was doin' his experiments. And if his notes are to be believed...

We need to find Naj'kula quickly--or she may not be who she was.
96451.title: A Child of Ula'tek

96457.description:
You saw what he did to Naj'kula. And who knows how many others.

<Ulantu is sweating and pale, gripping her stomach.>

Too many lives were sacrificed in de name of these awful... whatever Kuku became.

If only we could have killed de damned lich! But we can destroy his lab.
96457.title: Nothing Must Remain

96458.description:
Lokago cut me with de same venom that twisted Naj'kula. I feel it burnin' me just the same.

I intend to die an Amani. But my work is unfinished.

Please get these notes to Kul'amara.

Tell her she can find me at Naj'kula's side.
96458.title: Last Promise

96466.description:
Something is driving these creatures into our realm.

I have sent one of my most capable servants to this "Isle of Fangs". Go and see what you can make of this den of snakes. In any other endeavor I would accompany you, of course--but I shall remain here. 

This island sounds like a most dreadful place.

Do have fun, though.
96466.title: Prey: Anguish Island

96467.description:
Two brothers came with us to dis cursed place... Zei'ka and Jun'ka.

Zei'ka, he got de fire in him. Soon as we landed, he ran off, chasing whispers like dey were calling his name. But, Jun'ka, he ain't a fool. He went after his brother, tryin' to keep him from getting himself killed.

I don't like dis. Dis island, it'll swallow us whole if we ain't careful. Go check on dem, eh?
96467.title: Thirst for Knowledge

96469.description:
Jun'ka's my brother, but he frets too much to let me chase after my life's dream.

Ever since I was a child, I wanted to learn more of our history. While much of it is told by de talespinners back home, they always skipped one thing: Atal'Utek. De more I dug, de more mysterious it became, and de more I became engrossed.

Now, de scouts tell me that this crypt is filled with tablets inside. Tablets that could have de history of our people. I need to see those tablets, even if it kills me. You in?
96469.title: The Crypt of the Disgraced

96471.description:
Blast it all! I dragged y'all into dis muck just 'cause my brother's worried about my hide!

You're gettin' outta here quick! I lead, you follow, and don't lag behind, or you're squashed!
96471.title: Crumble and Tumble

96472.description:
The Hal'hadar may not know we are here yet, but they still hold the advantage.

Nexus-Captain Leth'ir and his associate, Mertei, are just over this ridge and surrounded by a small army.

If you can rally enough allies and catch their leaders off guard, we will deal a devastating blow before they know what hit them.

Proceed with caution, {name}, and make sure you are not alone.
96472.title: The Nexus-Captain

96473.description:
Like all domanaar, Imperator Pertinax sees himself only as a predator and never the prey.

Unfortunately, our prey is well-guarded in his Void Acropolis.

If you manage to gather enough allies and catch the imperator off guard, we'll deal a crushing blow to our enemies.

Move swiftly and cautiously, {name}, and ensure you have backup before engaging Pertinax.
96473.title: Imperator Pertinax

96474.description:
{name}! 

Ah, we haven't met. Not formally. I've overheard some of your discussions with Magister Astalor while I was, er, scrubbing the floors. You seem like quite the competent operator! That makes two of us.

Usually.

I'm a bit... preoccupied at the moment, what with the local wildlife and all. 

Maybe you can poke around for us?
96474.title: Prey: Something for Astalor

96475.description:
The domanaar Impotus sounds like he can be persuaded to set his sights elsewhere. 

Speaking with them directly will be challenging. They are distrustful, even of one another, as you can see from their projection devices. 

We must set a trap.

Take this soul gem and hunt the beings that inhabit the Acropolis. We will use the Void energy of this place against them.
96475.title: Captivating Science

96496.description:
During our surveys of this iced desert, our scouts identified two areas worth keeping an eye on, but with a major problem: they're only accessible through single points of entry.

Before I'm comfortable sending out more forces, we need to secure their exits.

We've been working on teleportation crystals for faster local travel that leverage the domanaar's existing portal network, and we're close to a solution. You just need to field test them.

Set up these prototype rift slippers and report back.
96496.title: The Road Not Taken Twice

96497.description:
The domanaar are more entrenched here than we thought and these storms refuse to relent even for a moment.

We've finally figured out how to hijack their portal network for short range traversal thanks to your efforts setting up the rift slippers. Now we just need help setting up our portal bridges.

Here are four strategic locations, including this outpost, for you to set up the portal bridges. Once active, you'll be able to more swiftly respond to threats as they arise.

Time to get to work.
96497.title: Spatial Reasoning

96503.description:
It appears your scouting has born fruit. This power could prove a useful boon indeed. 

Return to Atal'Utek and siphon its magic for our glorious purpose.
96503.title: Prey: A Ghostly Nightmare

96523.description:
These soldiers--dey are too young to remember the time before de loa gave us their help. So de loa can't come here. So? 

Let me tell a legend dat takes place before the loa helped our kind. Maybe you heard of it? Or maybe you want to see it for yourself...
96523.title: Living Legend

96525.description:
This is more than I'm prepared to deal with. 

I'll open a portal back to the Sanctum.

I'm going to wait for these blasted little snakelings to grow tired of me before following you through. Do put in a good word for me, please.
96525.title: Prey: Out of Our Depth

96528.description:
{name}! I tried to sneak away from those snakes, but one of them slithered up my pant leg and I blacked out for a bit.

When I awoke, I was here...

I wonder if there's anything in here that would interest Magister Astalor. 

Wait... what's that? That glowing...

It looks like your crystal is interacting with something in this tomb!
96528.title: Prey: Anguish from Beyond

96532.description:
My methods might come across as cruel and unusual to some, but I do take to heart the well being of those who serve under me. 

Most of the time.

Attendant Ethrandil has served our cause admirably. Please let him know he can return to me.

These floors have grown noticeably dirtier as of late...
96532.title: Prey: Attending the Attendant

96534.description:
My brother has always been the creative one, his hands busy on some intricate side project or some device he's working on. 

His enthusiasm will benefit this operation greatly, especially when it comes to thwarting the threats we face on this world.

See what he's been working on and give one of his new experiments a trial run.

I'm sure he'll be thrilled at the opportunity to contribute.
96534.title: Preparing for Threats

96536.description:
<It certainly is cold in this blizzard.

Perhaps someone back at camp can suggest a way to lessen its effects.>
96536.title: Bearing the Blizzard

96538.description:
I'm sure there is much we can do to help you with your problem.

Scattered out there is sure to be plenty of old demonic artifacts.

Search for fel embers and bring me back a few handfuls.
96538.title: Beating the Blizzard

96539.description:
Long, long ago, there was a village that suffered from a great drought. De crops wouldn't grow, and the land dried up. De whole village was starving! The villagers came to one troll--Jeytha--to ask her a favor. 

In dis story, you are Jeytha--now go see what those hungry villagers want!
96539.title: Last Resort

96540.description:
Jeytha came across a fox in de path, beset by lynx. And she was kind, and unafraid, and strong--so she decided to help that fox out. 

Now go tell those lynx to get outta here!
96540.title: Strong Hands

96541.description:
That sly old fox wasn't just any fox! He spoke, and he ran, and he waited for Jeytha to meet him. Now what did he want with Jeytha? 

You should talk to him and find out!
96541.title: Strong Mind

96542.description: Jeytha is smarter than that old fox. Watch what she says!
96542.title: Second to Last Resort

96543.description:
Now dat she was back where she started, Jeytha knew she couldn't make that journey. But what of de starving villagers? How would they survive?

Jeytha had a few ideas... if the villagers would listen to her. Go see what she has to say!
96543.title: Root of Survival

96544.description:
Years passed, and she didn't use dat third boon. One year, a flight of angry dragonhawks set their eyes--and flames--on de village. Her son was trapped, their home on fire! 

"I could use my boon," thought Jeytha, "But why use my boon, when I can use my strength?"

Go show those dragonhawks your strength, and save dat boy!
96544.title: Bravely Burning

96545.description:
The years passed, and still Jeytha did not use dat third boon. One year, a group of raiders arrived at de village, looking to steal everything dey had. 

"I could use dat third boon," Jeytha thought, "But why use dat boon when I can use my voice?"

Go talk those raiders down--and if dey don't listen, use your strength and change their minds!
96545.title: Strong Voice

96546.description:
The years passed, and Jeytha felt her time coming. She'd lived a long life, full of struggles but still happy. But as Jeytha reached the end of her days, dat sly old fox appeared. 

"Wait!" he said. "You can't go yet!"

Now what does that fox want? Go talk to him and find out!
96546.title: Strong Heart

96565.description:
You say it's still cold out there?

I can't say that I noticed. It's one of the few upsides of my current physical state.

There may still be more that can be done to help counteract the storms further. Hunt down stronger creatures and search their remains.

Let us once more foray into the past and acquire old legion technology. And by we, I mean you.
96565.title: Val Storm Mitigation 2

96567.description:
To understand the Hal'hadar's intentions with this world, we will need to secure information.

Knowing how they operate, they've restricted their data consoles with security measures in place.

<Y'mera smiles as she hands you a rune-carved crystal.>

This decrypter will automatically navigate their security. If you choose, you can engage the manual option to hasten the protocol.

Just remember to ignore any security warnings. My device can and will bypass it.
96567.title: Data Decryption Disaster

96568.description:
Y'mera's plan to intercept their data consoles will no doubt trigger heightened security protocols.

Normally, no-contact reconnaissance would be advised in this situation, but I think sowing chaos will be more beneficial.

The Hal'hadar won't be aware of their stolen data if their entire manaforge is under attack.

Dispatch any Hal'hadar agents you find.
96568.title: Hal'hadon't You Dare!

96569.description:
<The glowing rune-marked crystal atop the Hal'hadar's device seems to be siphoning arcane spores out of the air.

Although you're not quite sure what the device is, you get the feeling the crystal isn't quite ethereal in origin.

Y'mera would definitely be interested in examining some of these crystals.>
96569.title: Conductive Crystals

96570.description:
The Hal'hadar are notorious for looting and stealing technology from any world they descend upon.

Thanks to the intel you helped retrieve, we know they are using the manaforge east of us to experiment on whatever salvage they found.

Take this translocator with you and mark anything that doesn't resemble ethereal technology.

I will transport it back here for further study.
96570.title: Technological Transference

96571.description:
The manaforge to the east serves as both a research site and military compound, making it a valuable target.

Much of their research, including holoprint schematics, lays around the forge.

The Hal'hadar stationed here also carry nodes containing experimental and logistical data.

Take advantage of this accessible intel and bring back what you can find.
96571.title: The Node Knows

96572.description:
<From the runic communicator, you see a projection of a winged mechanical suit piloted by an ethereal. A voice emits from the device:

"Nullframe Soul-Fuse unsuccessful. Deployment from the Nexus Port halted. Troubleshooting in progress."

Whatever weapon the Hal'hadar created seems to be malfunctioning at the Transit Hub.

Intercepting and translocating the weapon back to Y'mera would deprive the ethereals of another weapon.>
96572.title: Malfunctioning Nullframe

96573.description:
It took some work, but we've cracked their ciphers.

The Hal'hadar seek to power their Nullframes using draenei vigilant technology.

The "Soul Lattice" is a heart for the Nullframe using a vigilant's core.

With it, they can bind their unwrapped energy into the core and wear the frame like armor.

The Hal'hadar must not succeed in finishing this prototype.

Y'mera is planning the next move. Speak with her.
96573.title: Soul Lattice Revealed

96574.description:
The tomb is called Vilaldoun. It means "island of the restful." Its entrance lies on the northern coast.

We know the Hal'hadar have established an extraction site outside the crypt, harvesting the local flora there to fuel their research.

As you approach, you will be met with heavy resistance.

Cut a path through their ranks while we establish a footing inside and meet us within.
96574.title: Cryptside Rendezvous

96575.description:
Without the tomb's defenses, the souls of the dead were easy targets for the Hal'hadar.

The ethereals intend to use the spirits to fuel the Soul Lattices for the Nullframe.

We must not let that happen.

Take my scepter and use it to repair the defense wards and shatter the energy cages binding the dead.

Once you've finished, regroup with Tala'saan in the lower chambers.
96575.title: Cages of the Soul

96576.description:
Defiling tombs... harnessing innocent souls as fuel...

The Hal'hadar are no better than demons.

If left unchecked, the ethereals will pilfer every grave and altar down here.

I may bear the title of "Souleater," but it doesn't mean I can't honor the dead in this forgotten place.

Recover the tributes the ethereals have stolen. Bring them to Tala'saan in the lower chamber.
96576.title: Mementos of the Dead

96577.description:
The architect leading their operation has found a single vigilant with an intact construct core.

The other vigilants in this chamber appear to be depleted.

If she succeeds in creating the Soul Lattice, the Hal'hadar will possess the means to turn our warframes into new armored bodies for their soldiers.

We must stop her now and recover the Soul Lattice prototype.
96577.title: The Soul Architect

96578.description:
Although she escaped, we have denied the architect her prototype... for now.

This Soul Lattice is fractured, but the core within still hums with a faint energy.

Perhaps this vigilant's soul yet remains...

If we hurry, perhaps Veraan and her brother can help stabilize the damage to preserve it.

I will regroup with Y'mera and Allari and meet you back at camp.
96578.title: Cryptic Departure

96583.description:
<The spores in this area are suffocating.

Perhaps someone back at camp can suggest a way to help mitigate their effects.>
96583.title: Suffering the Spores

96584.description:
Let's start with a simple test.

I have various materials that we could use to create a mask.

Why don't you test some and let me know how it goes?
96584.title: Surviving the Spores

96585.description:
We should first see how the local wildlife has adapted to these spores.

I would say return with a selection of fauna, but I'm not sure such fauna would be compliant with such a request.

Instead, you should just gather the pertinent parts that I would need to review for such a request.

Return with their lungs.
96585.title: Soothing the Spores

96612.description: <You hold the curio and discover a shimmering glow emanating from it. This looks important.>
96612.title: Ancient Curiosity: Combat

96615.description: <You hold the curio and discover a shimmering glow emanating from it. This looks important.>
96615.title: Ancient Curiosity: Utility

96633.description:
Welcome back, {name}! I've continued my collaboration with the artisans here in Silvermoon. Their techniques have only grown more refined. Infusing equipment with the essence of the dawn is no longer just theory, it's becoming an art form.

I'm eager to resume our work together. Bring me another piece of Adventurer equipment, and we'll see how these improved methods hold up in practice.

Plenty of people are always in need of a capable hand. Help them, and they'll reward you accordingly.
96633.title: Equipment Seminar

96635.description:
Cuzolth and I have pushed our craft further than ever, allowing us to imbue your gear with greater power.

To unlock its full potential, we'll need Mistcrests. They're drawn from trials of all kinds--greater dangers yield stronger crests, though even Adventurer Mistcrests carry a spark of that power.

Bring me fifty Adventurer Mistcrests, {name}. Let's see what your equipment is truly capable of.
96635.title: Upgrade Practicum

96637.description:
There is a lot more power where that came from!

Upgrades scale with strength. Higher quality items can reach higher heights of power. For this step, I'll need Veteran equipment along with some Veteran Mistcrests.

Once you bring them, Cuzolth and I can continue making the enhancements.
96637.title: Veteran Symposium

96639.description:
No sense standin' around. You've got a strong back and sharp eyes--best put them to use. We can't afford to let de serpents gain a single inch. 

Patrol de temple. You see someone who needs help? You help them. You find someone beyond saving? Make sure de fiends dat hurt them pay.
96639.title: Patrolling the Temple

96640.description: Dis temple holds many secrets, {name}. Ancient power, just waitin' for someone to take it. De Soulcoilers might be dead, but their power remains. Find their caches and bring me whatever you find.
96640.title: Bounty of the Cursed

96641.description:
Some say de forces of Ula'tek are endless--dat we can never kill them all.

<Socho grins.>

But I like a challenge. How 'bout you? Strike de enemy hard, and we'll see how endless dey are.
96641.title: Relentless Strikes

96642.description:
De strikes are de first step. We cannot let de enemy recover. First we batter them, soften 'em up. Then, we hit dem hard and fast with everything we've got. 

We don't have de forces for a longer battle. When de time comes for de incursion, you'd best be ready.

Gather your allies. De enemy is mighty.
96642.title: Decisive Incursions
