96643.description: Can you feel it? Old things lurk in de temple, just waitin' to rise once again. Dey are drawn by the sounds of battle, eager to visit their violence upon you. Find one of these ancient foes and ensure it does not rise again.
96643.title: From Whence it Came

96644.description:
I'm in need of venom, pure and potent. De venom dat wells up through de ground is too diluted--fouled with other things. You need to find a font of de profane stuff.

Search de depths of de vaults. Dat's where de true venom will be found.
96644.title: Essence of Malice

96649.description:
Crests aren't fixed in form, you can transmute them between tiers.

If you're holding crests beyond what your current gear can use, I can refine them into lower tiers. And once your equipment advances, we can reverse the process and elevate lesser crests into greater ones.

Let's start with a simple exercise. Bring me those Veteran Mistcrests, and I'll convert them into Adventurer Mistcrests.
96649.title: Mistcrest Capstone

96703.description:
When the Hal'hadar attacked, we quickly learned about their history with the Army of the Light.

Commander Tala'saan has been providing us information on these ethereals. His soldiers stand ready to join our cause.

I've requested their expertise in establishing a forward camp for our mission.

Aid them in their preparations and inform the commander we mobilize soon.
96703.title: Veterans of the Great Dark

96705.description:
Due to the nature of recent events, our operation is... unsanctioned.

Heavy losses prevent us from rallying large-scale support and Umbric cannot afford to upset tensions.

Fortunately, I've been in contact with a few volunteers ready to join our strike force.

I've marked their locations on your map.

Have them join us in the Voidstorm. I will meet you in the Howling Ridge when I am done here in Silvermoon.
96705.title: [DNT]

96708.description:
It may not seem like many, but the allies we've secured will have to be enough.

It's time we move out.

Our forces are gathering at the Howling Ridge. The energies of the Voidstorm will allow us to open the way to these worlds.

I will meet you there. There is something here I still require for our mission.
96708.title: To the Voidstorm and Beyond!

96709.description:
The Hal'hadar may not know we are here yet, but they still hold the advantage.

Nexus-Captain Leth'ir and his associate, Mertei, are just over this ridge and surrounded by a small army.

If you can rally enough allies and catch their leaders off guard, we'll deal a devastating blow before they know what hits them.

Proceed with caution, {name}, and make sure you are not alone.
96709.title: The Nexus-Captain (Heroic)

96710.description:
The Hal'hadar think they are alone here.

Normally, I'd prioritize reconnaissance, but there is an opportunity we must leverage.

Nexus-Captain Leth'ir and his associate, Mertei, are just over this ridge.

The bulk of the Hal'hadar appear to be spread across the swamp, which means their leaders are exposed.

If we strike them both down now, we deal a devastating blow to their operation.
96710.title: The Nexus-Captain (Mythic)

96711.description:
Like all domanaar, Imperator Pertinax sees himself only as a predator and never the prey.

Unfortunately, our prey is well-guarded in his Void Acropolis.

If you manage to gather enough allies and catch the imperator off guard, we'll deal a crushing blow to our enemies.

Move swiftly and cautiously, {name}, and ensure you have backup before engaging Pertinax.
96711.title: Imperator Pertinax (Heroic)

96712.description:
Like all domanaar, those stationed here on Val see themselves only as predators and never the prey.

This gives us an opportunity we must not squander.

Most of Pertinax's forces are occupied elsewhere or off-world, leaving our target exposed.

The imperator holds court in the bowels of this Acropolis.

Strike him down before he can rally his armies. End his threat once and for all.
96712.title: Imperator Pertinax (Mythic)

96713.description:
Our enemy's hold on Val may be strong, but it is not unbreakable.

For every monstrosity we cut down, we deny them another soldier to use against our world.

Venture out into the frozen landscape and lay waste to their strongholds.

Show them no mercy, {name}.
96713.title: Showdown on Val

96714.description:
Our enemy's hold on Val may be strong, but it is not unbreakable.

For every monstrosity we cut down, we deny them another soldier to use against our world.

Venture out into the frozen landscape and lay waste to their strongholds.

Show them no mercy, {name}.
96714.title: Showdown on Val (Heroic)

96716.description:
Our enemy's hold on Val may be strong, but it is not unbreakable.

For every monstrosity we cut down, we deny them another soldier to use against our world.

Venture out into the frozen landscape and lay waste to their strongholds.

Show them no mercy, {name}.
96716.title: Showdown on Val

96717.description:
Now this is quite a strange world, isn't it?

The Hal'hadar must have found something of note.

The stench of forges indicates they are plundering the riches and resources this remote rock has to offer.

If you can disrupt the operations here, you can buy your precious world a moment of respite.

Do what you do best, my little monster.
96717.title: Showdown on Naigtal

96718.description:
Now this is quite a strange world, isn't it?

The Hal'hadar must have found something of note.

The stench of forges indicates they are plundering the riches and resources this remote rock has to offer.

If you can disrupt the operations here, you can buy your precious world a moment of respite.

Do what you do best, my little monster.
96718.title: Showdown on Naigtal (Heroic)

96720.description:
Now this is quite a strange world, isn't it?

The Hal'hadar must have found something of note.

The stench of forges indicates they are plundering the riches and resources this remote rock has to offer.

If you can disrupt the operations here, you can buy your precious world a moment of respite.

Do what you do best, my little monster.
96720.title: Showdown on Naigtal

96725.description:
The mysterious world of Val has been made accessible to us with a host of new creatures present.

Go and see what you can find out about them.
96725.title: Sparks of War: Val

96726.description:
The mysterious world of Naigtal has been made accessible to us with a host of new creatures present.

Go and see what you can find out about this world and what the ethereals are up to.
96726.title: Sparks of War: Naigtal

96727.description:
Our effort to thwart the Void Assaults in Eversong and Zul'Aman have seen much success, but if we do not find a way to stop our aggressors from coming to our lands, they will bleed us until we can no longer stand.

Riftblade Maella has recently discovered the location of two of our enemies' bases. She seeks to take the fight to them. Will you aid her strike team?

Your efforts will not go unnoticed in these dark times!
96727.title: Midnight: Offworld Showdowns

96728.description:
After you reported thinning out their ranks I got to thinking. 

What do they use to recruit members? Are they just as fanatical as their leaders?

I wonder if we can break their will to fight by destroying a greater number of their ranks. I fear it will take more than one example to know for sure.
96728.title: Ritual Site Studies: Week 1 of 3

96729.description:
I have your next assignment, {race}. I need you to study the resilience of these malevolent boons and their dark obelisks.

They focus magic so well and the variety of boons is interesting. I need more data though.

When you disrupt the next ritual site I need you to do so with these malevolent boons present.
96729.title: Ritual Site Studies: Week 2 of 3

96730.description:
I think I am on the brink of a big discovery. These latest rituals involve a magic I had not previously heard of in the form of powerful embers that use the energy of their own forces to bolster their leader.

If you disrupt these rituals and report your findings to me, I might be able to put this magic to use for us. Do not look at me that way. On my own demon minions of course. Did you think I meant troops like you?

We are much too early for trials like that. Report back with your findings!
96730.title: Ritual Site Studies: Week 3 of 3

96731.description:
I had an idea right after you left. 

We have thinned out their ranks, we have also seen that they can summon additional reinforcements.

I want to test the limits of their reserves.

If you take on this set of challenges, I promise you another key for the vault.
96731.title: Advanced Ritual Site Studies: Week 4 of 6

96732.description:
Now that we have tested their troop reserves, our focus will be the dark obelisks and these boons they give.

This requires close scrutiny and will surely entail you facing increased patrols while you explore the site. Not too difficult for someone like yourself.

Just avoid them... or deal with them if you must.
96732.title: Advanced Ritual Site Studies: Week 5 of 6

96733.description:
Welcome back my star pupil. I have one last assignment for you and this one will be a challenge.

These embers that they use in these rituals. I have not had any success in replicating them or finding a way to counter them.

I have one last idea I want you to try. You reported seeing magical manifestations of caster spirits. I have a theory that with these two challenges present there might be a way for them to cancel each other out.
96733.title: Advanced Ritual Site Studies: Week 6 of 6

96744.description:
Hello! Here's a trick to help you bounce on the purple mushrooms around here. You'll need it, because...

I want some canopy specimens from the sporerays above us. Bounce up there, get some specimens, then come back down and I'll teach you how to ALWAYS bounce on those mushrooms.
96744.title: Bouncy Mushrooms

96745.description:
Now, practice using aerospores. They're up there too if you know where to look. Use them to shoot through the air!

You'll need to bounce on mushrooms to get up to the spores and see them. Once you're up there, pass through some aerospores and find out what they do!
96745.title: Aerospores

96746.description:
Need help! End of Harandar! End of world!

Spore Storm making something new for Grudge Pit, but too much. Too much! Can't control. Will break free! Destroy pit. Destroy us all!

Must go to Sporefall, destroy Rotmire before they lose control!

For Harandar! For Azeroth! For Grudge Pit!
96746.title: Sporefall: Rotmire

96801.description:
<You read a nearby advertisement...>

Run, don't walk!

The Artisan's Consortium has teamed up with local Silvermoon artisans in Falconwing Square to offer a new selection of heraldries and crafted equipment. These are certified for use in arenas and battlegrounds, guaranteed!

Head on down and look for Mirvedon to receive your free sample today.

Act now while supplies last! Terms and conditions apply.

-Aisha
96801.title: Calling All Combatants!

96808.description:
There's unknown danger out in the Coiled Isle.

Get out there and clear things up!
96808.title: Sparks of War: The Coiled Isle

96809.description:
Maneuvering through this spore-infested rock is quickly becoming a chore, I'm sure you would agree.

Thankfully, I've figured out a way to make use of the existing Manaforge Translocator network that was so thoughtfully built prior to our arrival.

I can show you how to "activate" them for our use. You can start with the one we... translocated to camp.
96809.title: Exterior Manaforge Translocator

96845.description: You have to try this Lightforge Hookshot! Here, take this loaner one. To learn the ropes, use it on some mushrooms and aerospores around here. Come back and I'll give you a Hookshot for keeps.
96845.title: The Grappler

96936.description:
{name}, you continue to impress me with your martial prowess!

You've done such an incredible job defeating the forces of evil. I've got something from my coffers that I'd love to give you.
96936.title: Accolades for the Umbral Contender

96995.description:
De temple can no longer contain Ula'tek's wrath. De boldest of her brood are spilling out all over de isle! They'll destroy us all if we don't stem de tide of venom.

Fight dem wherever dey dare to show their ugly heads. Do not let dem get a foothold.
96995.title: Turn Back the Surge

97016.description:
You think you've got some potent ingredients for my stew, eh? We'll see what de spirits think.

Show me what you've brought and I'll throw it in de cauldron. De spirits will eat their fill, and if dey like it, you might get a reward.

Or a punishment, if dey hate it. So choose wisely!
97016.title: Mixing Mysteries

97026.description:
<These mundane materials have acquired a queer shine to them, almost as if you are noticing a power latent in them that you could not perceive before.

Must have something to do with all that corrosion you've been consuming.

You aren't sure how to unlock that latent power, but perhaps there is someone more familiar with the esoteric magic of the isle that could help.>
97026.title: Esoteric Ingredients

97031.description:
<A brief glint sparkling in the shadows catches your eye.

As you pick up the object, the gem in its center flickers briefly, strange alien runes flashing across its surface.

For a moment, you see a flickering recorded projection of a male draenei mouthing silent words.

Y'mera will definitely be interested in this object.>
97031.title: Vilaldoun Valediction

97034.description:
Poor Impotus doesn't seem to believe we can seize control from his nefarious kin. He's tragically unimaginative.

We'll just need to show him an example of our combined strength. Slay that brute of a newcomer, Ignedus. I think his armor would look nice on our new savior.

Ignedus seems to be quite careful in showing his face, but clearly quick to anger. Get in there and make some noise, as you're so comfortable doing. I expect him to respond in kind.
97034.title: Vanquish the Warmonger

97035.description:
Defeating Ignedus is impressive, I suppose, but it does not mean you're any closer to taking Val. Periculus won't let you meddle with his playthings.

He is an... eccentric one, to say the least, and dreadfully fascinated by you flesh-beings.

You'll likely find him in the darkest hole this world has to offer, carving open the livestock that Pertinax gathered.

He likes to toy with his prey, so I would advise caution.
97035.title: Depose the Deranged

97036.description:
Well then, it seems our goals are more aligned than before. You've impressed me. With Ignedus and Periculus dealt with, all that remains is my former associate.

You will find Gladius Reginax atop that high platform, observing her quarry. She already knows you're coming, so don't aim to surprise her. There's only one way up there for you anyway: through that portal in the Glacial Reservoir.

I will play my part and join you. A symbol of our... collaboration.
97036.title: Umbral Title Bout

97037.description:
We have a problem, {name}.

The hologem you found revealed much about our people's time on this world and who the vigilants were in life.

Who they were is not the problem, but rather the possessions they carried within their chassis.

Possessions now in the hands of the Soul Architect who, as far as my scouts can tell, has left Naigtal.

Archmage Y'mera will explain in greater detail.
97037.title: Stargrim Revelations

97071.description:
Even with the element of surprise, we are at a disadvantage without allies.

Storming Pertinax's stronghold alone would be a death sentence.

Take this beacon Tala'saan gave us and return to our entry point.

I will meet you there and deliver my report to Maella.

Let us hope we have some sort of shelter awaiting us.
97071.title: A Frigid Welcome to Val

97072.description:
The Nexus-Captain is just over that hill, unaware of our arrival.

Attacking now would catch his army off guard... and likely result in our demise.

No matter what, we will need allies if we are to succeed.

Use this beacon to return to our invasion point.

By now, Y'mera has likely brought in the rest of our forces to support us.

Speak with Maella when you arrive.
97072.title: A Swampy Welcome to Naigtal

97077.description:
Now that our trap is attuned, we just need to lure our prey out into the open.

I have strategically... dismantled... certain parts of the projection device I obtained. Impotus should have difficulty seeing and hearing you clearly.

Claim to be one of his allies and demand a meeting at once. We will hope his curiosity gets the better of him.

And then... 

<Leona holds up the void-infused gem, glances at it for a moment, then nods at you.>
97077.title: A Shot at the Dark

97080.description:
We must not let up the pressure.

Even now they are rebuilding from our attacks.

Venture out again and show them no mercy!
97080.title: More Disruptions: Val

97081.description:
We must not let up the pressure. Even now they are rebuilding from our attacks. 

Venture out again and again show them no mercy!
97081.title: More Disruptions: Val (Heroic)

97082.description:
Our scouts have reported seeing dangerous elite creatures that are hampering our efforts. 

I need you to dispatch them so we can continue our primary objective.
97082.title: Dangerous Enemies: Val

97083.description:
Our scouts have reported seeing dangerous elite creatures that are hampering our efforts. 

I need you to dispatch them so we can continue our primary objective.
97083.title: Dangerous Enemies: Val (Heroic)

97084.description:
The stench of their forges still lingers. This means they are rebuilding. 

You must keep at it if you hope to disrupt their operations enough to end their threat.

Now you can go. Wreak havoc.
97084.title: More Disruption: Naigtal

97085.description:
I hear your scouts talk of dangerous creatures and foes they have faced. 

It makes me wonder if you could defeat them? Why don't you go and try? It will certainly help your efforts here.

I hope to see you return mostly intact.
97085.title: Dangerous Enemies: Naigtal

97086.description:
I hear your scouts talk of dangerous creatures and foes they have faced. 

It makes me wonder if you could defeat them? Why don't you go and try? It will certainly help your efforts here.

I hope to see you return mostly intact.
97086.title: Dangerous Enemies: Naigtal (Heroic)

97087.description:
The stench of their forges still lingers. This means they are rebuilding. 

You must keep at it if you hope to disrupt their operations enough to end their threat.

Now you can go. Wreak havoc.
97087.title: More Disruption: Naigtal (Heroic)

97141.description:
It takes de whole of our strength to keep de forces of Ula'tek from overwhelming de isle. Dat battle is waged inside the Vault of Ula'tek, against the endless tide of her children. Kill one, and two more will slither out of de venom.

Venture in, {name}, and lend your power to our weary fighters. Who knows? You may even find something valuable in dat ancient, cursed place.
97141.title: Spoils of the Vaults

97215.description:
We have struck a major blow against our enemies. Still, they continue their assaults.

Decimus and my riftwardens have targeted another world from which they launch these attacks.

The bulk of our forces have temporarily withdrawn to the Voidstorm so that we may begin our assault on this second world.

Our strike team awaits us at the Howling Ridge.
97215.title: A Secondary Strike

97256.description:
Even the most ruthless of creatures falter when they see their greatest champions crumble to ash.

Remind our enemies here just how quickly their leaders fall!

Let them know just how unrelenting and vicious you monsters of Azeroth really are! Bring me the Void Commander's Emblems and I will reward you accordingly.
97256.title: Knocking Off the Top (Heroic)

97321.description:
I've got good news and bad news.

Bad is that all those curios we dug up together? Melted.

Good news? I've found some very interesting new poisons to work with.

But let me explain what happened...
97321.title: Slithering Spoils

97381.description:
I have watched the effort and care you take with the other mortals of your neighborhood, here in Founder's Point. This ceaseless labor on their behalf is the sort of behavior that I encourage. There's no profit to be had for you, but that isn't a driving concern for the best of your kind.

In recognition of your efforts and status, I offer you a gift. This small device contains a piece of decor for you to place in your home. I will have another for you next week.
97381.title: A Curated Gift

97382.description:
Every part of dis isle is cursed, {name}. When de curse of Ula'tek coalesces into a fight, dat is when it is most important to strike back. We need all de help we can get keeping it at bay.

You look strong... but you'll need better equipment if you want to stay alive.

Defeat the leader of one of dese surges, and then we can discuss a reward.
97382.title: Counter-Curse Bounty

97383.description: Our scouts found dis relic in one of da crypts. Maybe Er'inye knows what to do with it?
97383.title: Spirit Corrosion

97384.description: One of those soulcoilers was carrying dis gem. You should show it to Er'inye.
97384.title: More Spirit Corrosion

97454.description:
Since the opening of the Coiling Isles, things have started to get interesting again in delves.

See if our dear hosts have anything they can spare for those of us actually risking our necks and check the Delver's Guide for any updates.

A quick refresher never hurt anyone.
97454.title: Seasonal Refresher: Midnight

97455.description:
<Years beneath the waves should have erased its details, yet the bell remains remarkably well-preserved. Whatever purpose it once served, the runes carved into it were clearly meant to endure.

A sense of foreboding comes over you as you consider ringing it. Maybe not.

Sluggs probably knows something about this item.>
97455.title: Call of the Bell

97457.description:
<These appear to be a large pair of hand bones, that someone has hollowed out and claimed to be gauntlets.

It's a good thing you're already wearing gauntlets, or you'd be tempted to try them on.

Sluggs probably knows something about this item.>
97457.title: Fits Like a Glove

97458.description:
<An endless supply of fishing gear would be a dream for most anglers. The fact that this tacklebox screams whenever it is opened likely explains why it ended up at the bottom of the sea.

After spending enough time with it, the screams start to echo without needing to open it at all.

Sluggs probably knows something about this item.>
97458.title: Tackled and Boxed

97459.description:
<The inscription promises to not only attract spirits, but to whip them into a violent frenzy if enough is burned. That can't end well.

Still, it does smell nice.

Sluggs probably knows something about this item.>
97459.title: Something Smelly

97460.description:
<The pouch is unremarkable, but its history may not be. Ritual salts have long been used to call upon ancestors, spirits, and powers beyond the mortal world.

This salt is extra-salty, having been in the ocean. Perhaps that makes it extra-potent?

Sluggs probably knows something about this item.>
97460.title: Lightly Salted

97461.description:
<Most fishing manuals concern themselves with bait, weather, and patience. This weathered tome boasts lessons on hexing one's fishing rivals and communing with the deep.

You sense you are wading into dangerous waters.

Sluggs probably knows something about this item.>
97461.title: Cursed Fishing 101

97462.description:
<This faceted ore hums with an unsettling energy. Whether it is valued more for its practical uses or its strange properties, you cannot say.

You feel compelled to lick it, though you know you shouldn't.

Sluggs probably knows something about this item.>
97462.title: Rocky Shores

97463.description:
<This blade shows no signs of battle wear, only careful maintenance. Its purpose was clearly ceremonial, but for what ceremony?

The red gleam to the metal gives you a clue.

Sluggs probably knows something about this item.>
97463.title: Just a Normal Knife

97464.description:
<The glass is thick and reinforced, suggesting the contents were considered dangerous--or valuable. The verdant liquid within glimmers as it shifts in the vial.

You think you smell something acrid and noxious about it. But it could be that this whole isle smells acrid and noxious.

Sluggs probably knows something about this item.>
97464.title: A Dash of Poison

97465.description:
<It's a spear. The fishing rod is a spear.

Sluggs probably knows something about this item.>
97465.title: The Intended Way to Fish

97482.description:
That snake monstrosity was vicious, with venom potent enough to burn through stone.

We'll want to make sure we get our hands on the best gear we can before we think about taking it on.

I've got some ideas about turning that venom to our own ends, though, so we can hit the ground running.
97482.title: Fangs for the Memories

97521.description:
Greetings, settler!

There's a cove off the coast that my people have turned into a tavern. It's open year round, but we like to help drum up some business for them whenever we come to town. Would you care to help?
97521.title: A Turtle Bade It to the Water

97535.description:
<A voice hisses in your mind.>

Am I to be another victim in your pointless conquest? I wonder... will you skin me alive and boil me in a stew? Or simply leave me to rot on a pile of your forgotten excess?

What if I can offer you something... better? Something... delicious. The Children of Ula'tek are a blight on this world. On this we agree. Bring me proof of their demise.
97535.title: A Bargain You Won't Refuse

97557.description:
Toxic Tlhapi. Nasty little fish.

Everything's wrong about them, from their big, buggy eyes to their sweet, succulent meat...

<Gills clears their throat.>

Not to mention the toxicity. The seas would be much better without them fouling things up.
97557.title: Tailing the Tlhapi

97559.description:
Surely by now even you understand the threat Ula'tek poses, yes? Her wretched power oozes forth time and time again.

If I am to do my part, I will need proof of your devotion to our... agreement, shall we call it? When next her acolytes call forth their twisted mongrels, slay them and collect their remains.
97559.title: The Familiar Taste of Poison

97562.description:
Spotted Killifish. Grotesque little creatures.

The little demons swarm like insects, washing up on shores in such horrific numbers that it would take several meals to devour them all.

<Gills' belly burbles audibly.>

You can do your part by collecting some for me, ridding the waters of their foul presence.
97562.title: Culling the Killifish

97565.description:
<The wretched things you gathered briefly wink out of existence, returning in the same breath as one object.>

Go on, take it. Carry it to the Vaults of Atal'Utek. Affix it to that dismal rod of yours and cast it into the fetid pools to draw out one of Ula'tek's pets. You do have the skill to fish anywhere, don't you?
97565.title: Tipping the Scaled

97571.description:
Dirty Darters. Ghoulish little buggers.

The way they flit about the water is so unnerving, so disquieting, one can't help but imagine them darting right down one's gullet...

<Gills coughs rather loudly>

You can do your part by collecting some for me, ridding the waters of their foul presence.
97571.title: Dogging the Darters

97616.description:
<You feel a change in the air as you take this ancient volume into your hands.

Though it prickles and burns your skin, your mind radiates with thoughts of the power it contains and the peril it represents.

You must know more.

There is only one place on the isle profane enough for this tome. In your mind's eye, you glimpse the Altar of Corrosion.>
97616.title: Corrosive Gifts: Corrosive Power

97621.description:
Our sojourn to this world has brought the ren'dorei an even deeper understanding of the Void than before. The domanaar with whom we share a common enemy are almost strangely generous with their knowledge. I believe they want us to become as fearsome as they are.

There is a Singularity Anchor in Stormarion Citadel. I have learned how to draw upon some of its power to craft you a powerful item.

But first, we must ensure it does not fall into the hands of our enemies.
97621.title: The Singularity Anchor

97622.description:
You seek an audience with Saltheril? And you're wearing... that? Excuse me for a moment while I laugh into my handkerchief.

<Caeris laughs lightly behind his handkerchief.>

Now, let me be professional. You are cordially invited to attend Saltheril's soiree.

Don't embarrass yourself, {name}. The best of Silvermoon are watching.
97622.title: A Soiree to Remember

97624.description: Harandar hides wisdom in every annal of its history, {name}. You would do well to seek out its legends for yourself. I suspect you may learn something of this world and our places in it.
97624.title: Seeking Legends

97625.description:
De Loa of Abundance may not be one of de four great ones, but his worshippers are certainly de most devout.

Seek him out yaself. You can find him in northern Zul'Aman near Halazzi's Temple, but I also hear he's established harvest sites in Eversong Woods, Harandar, and even de land of Void through de gargantuan skymouth.

If nothing else, de rewards he grants are glorious--to de worthy, at least.
97625.title: Glorious Abundance

97640.description:
You don't look so good, {name}.

<As Abdumati examines you grimly, your heart starts pounding and your vision goes green. The weight of the coin in your pocket feels overwhelming.>

You found something out dere, huh? De vaults are full of treasure, most of it cursed.

I don't trust her, but dat spirit-witch you saw knows all de secrets of dis horrid place. If anyone can help, it's her.
97640.title: Vaults of Atal'Utek: One Coin Too Many

97661.description:
<This amulet feels warm and smooth in your hand.

As you hold it, you feel relief from the weight of your corrosion, as if the amulet offers some protection from Ula'tek's curse.

Er'inye would likely be interested in studying it.>
97661.title: The Protection of the Med'jai

97662.description:
<As your hand closes around this fragile feather, a spectral wind echoes through the vaults.

With it, you feel the weight of your spirit's corrosion lift, as if you could simply spread your wings and fly out of this cursed place.

You can't, of course. But Er'inye might be interested in studying it.>
97662.title: The Winds of Tok'jara

97668.description:
<Clutching the serpentine eyeball, you feel a new awareness creeping up the back of your neck.

The Eggs of Ula'tek. By the hundreds. You can sense their every twitching presence, waiting to burst into vile venom and more of her wretched spawn.

You wish you could toss it into the deepest crypt, but its power is undeniably potent. Er'inye would be interested in studying it.>
97668.title: The Watchful Gaze of Szarith

97669.description:
<You hold a simple lynx's paw, worn by time and worry, that the spirit left as a parting gift.

Though it holds no magical properties of its own, it is swollen with the hopes and fears of every bound spirit that crossed its path in this miserable place.

The result is quite potent, if emotionally harrowing. Er'inye would likely be interested in studying it.>
97669.title: The Luck of the Bound Spirit

97910.description:
Fragmentary images of heroic deeds flash through your mind as you touch the stone, but they fade as fast as they arrive.

Perhaps performing a suitably impressive task will stabilize the stone's magic once more?
97910.title: Cracked Keystone

97945.description:
Ah, {name}! Good. Now that you've helped me amass such a wealth of resources, it's time for me to pursue other... interests.

What? You expected a more dramatic betrayal? Never!

Don't worry, {name}, while I may be occupied elsewhere, I'll never tire of watching your adventures.

Adventures still bolstered by my gifts, of course. Many have shown interest, but I've only found one void elf... amusingly strange enough to mentor.

Orin Straylight is the name. You'll find him by the Catalyst in Silvermoon.
97945.title: In the Catalyst's Shadow

97978.description:
Greetings, {class}. Our mutual friend explained everything to us. Don't worry, my shade and I took to Decimus' voidweaving like fish to water.

We had an idea. The Catalyst's transformative energies are immense and span the breadth of known elemental forces.

If I can learn to isolate the void from that spectrum of power, I could use it to weave Nebulous Voidcores just as Decimus did with the Voidforge.

We are no domanaar, though. We need practice.
97978.title: Prismatic Potential

97981.description: I'm glad you're here, {name}. I've worked it all out! I can filter the Catalyst's energies through a void prism to isolate the bands necessary to weaving Nebulous Voidcores.
97981.title: Umbral Blessings of the Catalyst

98172.description:
We must not lose sight of our true goal here in Silvermoon, {name}: to bring Xal'atath to justice.

We all saw her void armies at the Sunwell. They were rushing downward, INTO the well, a thousand a minute. And now: silence.

Listen for their whispers, {class}. With any luck, we'll pick up on their trail again, and then we'll find Xal'atath... and perhaps even those that pursued her.
98172.title: Trailing Xal'atath

98204.description:
<A containment shield hums, wrapping tightly about the keepsake. The object projects an aura of sorrow and suffering.

According to the Last Architect, this keepsake is cursed, but it can be cleansed. One must simply fold their essence inside that of the object and remove the corruption from within. How dangerous could it be?>
98204.title: Cursed Keepsake

98218.description:
{name},

Your aid is requested in Amani'Zar Village. Please meet me there.

--Liadrin
98218.title: Return to Amani'Zar

98220.description:
The Children of Ula'tek writhe at the heart of her temple, mutating into more and more wretched versions of themselves. If left unchecked, they'll soon become venomous monstrosities we have no hope of fighting.

I hate to send you into a den of vipers, {name}, but we have no other choice. Get in there and thin out the swarm, before those vile serpents devour the world.
98220.title: Altar of Fangs

98226.description: If my brother is no longer bowing to Malacrass, then he's in grave danger. We need to find a way to get to dem as quickly as possible. Look for anything that could let us get through de temple faster.
98226.title: The Venomous Abyss: Deception Unmasked

98228.description: If my brother is no longer bowing to Malacrass, then he's in grave danger. We need to find a way to get to dem as quickly as possible. Look for anything that could let us get through de temple faster.
98228.title: The Venomous Abyss: Deception Unmasked

98229.description: If my brother is no longer bowing to Malacrass, then he's in grave danger. We need to find a way to get to dem as quickly as possible. Look for anything that could let us get through de temple faster.
98229.title: The Venomous Abyss: Deception Unmasked

98232.description:
Zul'jarra's forces stand watch at the gates of the Vaults of Atal'Utek, holding the line against those wicked serpents.

The fate of the entire Eastern Kingdoms rests on their blades. We would do well to provide them with reinforcements. The Children of Ula'tek are fierce, but they are no match for a seasoned {class} like you.

Traverse the temple and thin their ranks, however you can.
98232.title: Midnight: Vaults of Atal'Utek

98234.description:
Interested in training against some of our fighters? Step into the ring and show us your mettle.

Make sure you equip these medallions, and defeat at least two teams of enemies.
98234.title: Week 1 of 3: Gladiator's Distinction

98295.description: Good work using your Gladiator's Distinction bonus. Now I want you to try defeating some enemy teams after landing a crowd control effect!
98295.title: Week 2 of 3: Crowd Control

98311.description: I have one final lesson for you. Get in there and interrupt an enemy spell cast, or dispel a harmful effect from yourself or an ally. Then, defeat your enemy two more times.
98311.title: Week 3 of 3: Interrupts and Dispels

98343.description:
Before I send ye out hunting, ye should acquaint yerself with what remains of my crew.

Most perished in the wreck, of course. Others fell into the swamp. Some traitorous gits... well, we'll get to them in a moment, won't we?

But me loyal second mate is holding down the fort, just down river of me Landing. She'll set you up right.
98343.title: Venom Fishing: My Second-Best

98388.description:
Past dis bulwark, there's nothin but snakes, spirits, and venomous death.

I've lost three lieutenants dis week. Strong ones. Brave ones. Maybe stronger and braver than you.

<Warleader Abdumati looks you over with a weary eye.>

If you want to fling yaself into de abyss, be my guest. Bring back my scouts, if you can find dem amongst de bones.

But watch your step. Dat venom will swallow you whole.
98388.title: Into the Vaults of Atal'Utek

98406.description:
I have watched the effort and care you take with the other mortals of your neighborhood, here in Razorwind Shores. This ceaseless labor on their behalf is the sort of behavior that I encourage. There's no profit to be had for you, but that isn't a driving concern for the best of your kind.

In recognition of your efforts and status, I offer you a gift. This small device contains a piece of decor for you to place in your home. I will have another for you next week.
98406.title: A Curated Gift

98414.description:
Oh, uh. The Captain has requested you join him at Tokka's Landing as soon as you can.

<Second Mate Sluggs quivers in her shell.>

He had a mean look about him. Tread lightly.
98414.title: A Request from the Captain

98415.description:
Oh! While you were out fishing, Captain Tokka asked to see you again. I think he's beginning to trust you.

<Second Mate Sluggs grimaces.>

The Captain's trust d-does tend to come with caveats.
98415.title: A Favor to the Captain

98416.description:
Ohh, the Captain's really in a foul mood this time. I think you'd better go see what he wants.

<Second Mate Sluggs shakes her head.>

You're the only one who can soothe his storms, these days.
98416.title: A Plea from the Captain

98419.description:
De Vaults are a dangerous place. Lotta brave, headstrong fighters think dey can face de Children of Ula'tek alone. If dey're lucky, we manage to recover de bodies before dey get eaten.

I like you, {name}. It'd be a shame to see a serpent feed you to its young. So be smart. Find people to watch your back, then carve your way through de temple together.
98419.title: Shoulder to Shoulder

98420.description:
Knowledge is de most important weapon in war. These Vaults are ancient and vast--our scouts cannot see everything. What lurks in de depths of these corrupted halls?

Dat's precisely what I need to know. Get out there and tell me what you see, but it's dangerous to go alone. You best bring some comrades if you want to make it back.
98420.title: What's Out There?

98428.description:
De Altar of Corrosion.

Who can say when dis accursed piece of stone rose out of de venom? I have studied it for lifetimes and have only just tasted its power.

<Er'inye licks her spectral lips.>

Say de word, and I will convert de corrosion you carry to something more useful. Den, you may commune with de Altar and accept its many gifts.
98428.title: Vaults of Atal'Utek: The Altar of Corrosion

98515.description:
Dis temple is where all de Children of Ula'tek first crawl out of de ooze. Dis is where we hold de line.

De threat comes in waves. Sometimes short strikes. Sometimes an incursion dat overwhelms de whole temple. Sometimes a huge monstrosity rising out of de venom.

Whatever dey send, send it back cryin' to its big evil mama!

And in de meantime, do what you can to keep our patrols safe.
98515.title: Vaults of Atal'Utek: A Toxic Tour
